characters.title: A. Phex Brothers
characters.name_ja: エイ・フェックス兄弟
characters.bio: The A. Phex Brothers are secondary antagonists featured in the eighth part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, JoJolion, specifically the "Love Love Deluxe" story arc.
characters.background: The A. Phex Brothers were born as nameless Rock Humans, and subsequently took their names from normal humans. At one point in their lives, they became assassins for the Locacaca Organization.
characters.personality: The pair share a duality described as harmonious with one another, being based on the Japanese concept of 'A-un', which explains the connected nature of opposites and their seemingly contradictory similarities.
characters.ja_kanji: エイ・フェックス兄弟

characters.title: Abbacchio's Partner
characters.name_ja: アバッキオの同僚の警官
characters.bio: Abbacchio's Partner is an unnamed posthumous tertiary character featured in the fifth part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, Vento Aureo.
characters.background:
.
One night, the man and his partner received a report that a robber had broken into an old man's house (in the anime, the report was a shop being robbed). The two rushed to the scene; Abbacchio went through the back and found the criminal he had made a deal with earlier. In their confrontation, Abbacchio was too hesitant to do anything and didn't realize the criminal pulling his gun out. At that moment, Abbacchio's partner jumped in and both he and the criminal fired at each other. The criminal was merely shot in the arm, but Abbacchio's partner was fatally shot in the chest and he immediately died.
characters.personality: Abbacchio's partner is a brave and selfless crime fighter, non-hesitant on sacrificing his own life to shoot an armed criminal. In the afterlife, he portrays an analytical behavior, as he is seen carefully inspecting pieces of broken glass. His philosophy is to search for not just the result, believing that if one tries to search for just the result they "lose sight of the truth". He also believes that what's important is the will to seek out the truth, and that even if a perpetrator got away, all that matters is if he's reached his "destination".
characters.ja_kanji: アバッキオの同僚の警官

characters.title: Adams
characters.bio: Adams is a tertiary antagonist featured in the first part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, Phantom Blood.
characters.personality: Adams initially appears as a normal adult, lecturing Poco that a child like him shouldn't be out so late at night. He can be somewhat immature as he mimics cow horns with his fingers while teasing Poco that his sister will lock him in a barn.

characters.title: Akemi, Yoshie, and Reiko
characters.name_ja: アケミ・ヨシエ・レイコ
characters.bio: Akemi, Yoshie, and Reiko are a group of tertiary characters featured in the fourth part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, Diamond is Unbreakable. The three are delinquent fan-girls of Yuya Fungami that appear during the "Highway Star" and "Enigma Boy" story arcs.
characters.personality: Akemi, Yoshie, and Reiko are three delinquent girls smitten with Yuya Fungami.
characters.ja_kanji: アケミ・ヨシエ・レイコ

characters.title: Alison Alohaoe
characters.name_ja: アリソン・アロハオエ
characters.bio: Alison Alohaoe is a tertiary character featured in the ninth part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, The JOJOLands.
characters.background: Alison lived with her children in an apartment in Oahu. Despite having a husband, Alison is known to be infatuated with Max and had been seeing him for a while. After her husband got hit by a bus and passed away, she received the insurance money. The family had paid $15,000 in medical expenses related to Tory's condition within a year.
characters.personality: According to Usagi Alohaoe, Alison is a responsible parent, especially in how she cares for Tory Alohaoe in spite of the family's difficulties. Despite this, Usagi also describes his relationship with Alison as distant and strained. After his father died, Alison struggled to support the family and became increasingly focused on Tory. When Usagi was 14, he told her he had a crush on a male friend from another school. Alison reacted by sending him to a correctional facility, revealing her homophobia. Ever since that incident, she has been giving Usagi the cold shoulder, preferring to focus on her daughter.
characters.ja_kanji: アリソン・アロハオエ

characters.title: Amato
characters.bio: Amato is a tertiary ally featured in the first part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, Phantom Blood. He is a Chinese who originally tries to rob Jonathan Joestar in Ogre Street alongside Robert E. O. Speedwagon and Tattoo.
characters.personality: Little is known of Amato's personality, but he is prideful of his self-proclaimed martial arts techniques. Like his friends, he has a rowdy nature and is violent towards strangers who enter his gang's territory.

characters.title: Anakiss
characters.bio: Anakiss is a tertiary character featured in the sixth part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, Stone Ocean.
characters.background: During the acceleration of time caused by Made in Heaven, Emporio Alnino defeats Pucci before the universe's cycle can be completed, which alters fate's course in the next cycle of the universe. Thus, the souls of Anasui, Jolyne, Jotaro, and their deceased allies are reborn, albeit with different memories. Anasui is now named Anakiss, and Irene is his girlfriend.
characters.personality: Presumably not as maniacal as his original self due to not being a convict, Anakiss is a typical carefree juvenile who is in a relationship with his girlfriend, Irene. He appears friendly enough to offer strangers a ride when it's raining.

characters.title: Anita
characters.bio: Anita is a tertiary character featured in the fifth part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, Vento Aureo.
characters.background: Not much is known about Anita's past, as Melone uses her only for Junior's production. However, according to her, her family ranks high up in the police and government.
characters.personality: Anita is an arrogant and spoiled woman. She is quick-tempered and prone to hysteria. When angered by someone, she easily becomes violent. She is shown complaining about the noise from other passengers and calls them "peasants". She is a smoker and drinker according to Melone, and a glass of wine can be seen next to her in her compartment.

characters.title: Anjuro Katagiri
characters.bio: Anjuro Katagiri, better known as Angelo, is a secondary antagonist featured in the fourth part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, Diamond is Unbreakable, specifically in the "Josuke Higashikata! Meets Angelo" story arc.
characters.background: Anjuro Katagiri was born in 1964 in Morioh. At the age of 12, he was convicted for robbery and rape after being arrested by Ryohei Higashikata and was sent to a juvenile prison. Since then, he was in and out of prisons all across Japan, constantly repeating his crimes. He eventually became known as the most depraved criminal in Japan, with the newspapers giving him the nickname "Angelo". In March 1994, Angelo encountered three 14-year-old-boys. He raped two of them, killed them, and stole everything they had. When he was about to kill the third teenager, he realized the boy was the only child of wealthy parents and kidnapped the boy instead so he could demand ransom. Despite pretending to ha
characters.personality: Angelo is one of Japan's most corrupt, degenerate criminals. He has committed countless crimes, including robbery, kidnapping, ransom, and rape, since he was 12 years old. He is especially sexually depraved, having committed rape at 12 years old and raping two 14-year-old boys later on. Evidently, Angelo feels no remorse for any of his crimes, even admitting that he is a damned soul. To him, committing crimes, especially with his Stand, is a fun pastime. People that interrupt his plans infuriate him, so he naturally tries to kill them.

characters.title: Arnold
characters.bio: Arnold is a tertiary ally featured in the fourth part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, Diamond is Unbreakable.
characters.background: Arnold was Reimi's guard dog 16 years prior to Diamond is Unbreakable. One night, Yoshikage Kira invaded their house and slashed his throat. Picking up the dog's dead body, Kira hanged him on the clothes hook in the wall, his neck almost cut off. His blood remained dripping for more than 10 minutes before anyone noticed his death. Living as ghosts bound within a ghost alley, Reimi and Arnold await the day they can find someone to hear their story and report Kira to the police before more girls are killed.
characters.personality: As a guard dog, Arnold is strong and fierce to his enemies. However, he is friendly to strangers, as he didn't attack Rohan and Koichi when they stumbled into the alley. Loyal to his master, he remains by Reimi's side even in the afterlife.

characters.title: Atroe
characters.bio: Atroe is a tertiary character featured in the sixth part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, Stone Ocean.
characters.background: As a child, Atroe had an odd obsession with being kidnapped. She considered being swept away and would let herself get lost in department stores. When she became an adult, she kidnapped a child for ten days. She didn't do it for ransom, and only did it for sport. She ended up getting sentenced to seven years at Green Dolphin Street Prison. In prison, Atroe would get constantly bullied by the other inmates.
characters.personality: Atroe first gives off the impression of a shy prisoner who is an easy target of bullying for the other inmates. The reason why she decided to join the search party is so that she has time off of being bullied in prison. As revealed by Foo Fighters, Atroe had a childhood dream of getting kidnapped, purposely getting lost in department stores. In fact, she kidnapped a child for ten days for sport.

characters.title: Atsunori Iwakiri
characters.bio: Atsunori Iwakiri, nicknamed God Shoulder Ah-kun or more simply as Ah-kun, is a tertiary character featured in the eighth part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, JoJolion.
characters.background: Atsunori Iwakiri is the star pitcher of the Seiten Birdies baseball team, nicknamed "God Shoulder Ah-kun" by the crowd for his heavenly pitching. In 2009, he had a salary of ¥300,000,000. However, in 2010, he damaged his right shoulder with little hope of recovery and was listed on the disabled list shortly before he was going to be accepted into the major leagues, ruining his career.
characters.personality: Formerly a promising sports star fallen from grace due to his shoulder injury, Atsunori Iwakiri is desperate to save his own career. Failing to join the major leagues after going on a disabled list, he buys a Locacaca fruit for ¥200,000,000 from Aisho Dainenjiyama to recover his shoulder. He is at first skeptical of Aisho and the fruit.

characters.title: Ayana Hirose
characters.bio: Ayana Hirose is a tertiary character featured in the fourth part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, Diamond is Unbreakable.
characters.personality: Ayana is a kind, polite young lady. She cares for her brother and calls him "Ko-chan" like their mother. She is also seen to enjoy occasionally teasing Koichi. She is kind to strangers, smiling at Koichi's friends and offering Tamami tea when he visits.

characters.title: Aztec Chief
characters.bio: The Aztec Chief is an unnamed tertiary character featured in the opening sequence of the first part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, Phantom Blood.
characters.background: The chieftain of an Aztec tribe, he performed sacrficial rituals for his people.
characters.personality: As the leader of his tribe, he is viewed by his people as proud and powerful. He is shown to be power-hungry, as he declares that he has finally gained eternal life after becoming a vampire. He also seems to be careless in regards to his people, as he slams one of his followers into the ground after draining their life force. His tribe is known to be cannibalistic and to hold sacrificial rituals similar to the one shown.

characters.title: Barbara Ann Joestar
characters.name_ja: バーバラ・アン・ジョースター
characters.bio: Barbara Ann Joestar is a tertiary character featured in the ninth part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, The JOJOLands.
characters.background: Barbara Ann Joestar and her husband moved to, Hawaii from when Dragona was 14 and Jodio was 11 years old. She was a stay-at-home mom, but had a bit of a strained relationship with her husband.
characters.personality: Barbara is a diligent individual and although slightly strict at times, is a loving mother who thoroughly looks out for her children. She is a hard worker who takes on two jobs to support her family after her husband left home. Her day begins with a strict routine: waking up at 6:45 in the morning, starting the washing machine, then getting dressed in the bathroom. She prepares a nutritious breakfast that includes toast, fruit, ham, and eggs—fried or boiled for seven minutes—along with fried broccoli. Afterward, she wakes up her children with a good-morning kiss and hangs the laundry out to dry before catching the bus to go to work at 8:06 A.M. She staunchly refuses to accept a diagnosis of

characters.title: Bruford
characters.bio: Bruford is a secondary antagonist featured in the first part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, Phantom Blood. He briefly becomes a tertiary ally later in the part.
characters.background: Born in the 16th century, Bruford was a member of the and a retainer of Mary Stuart. After losing his relatives in previous wars, young Bruford was brought up as Mary Stuart's knight and trained his body for that sole purpose. Bruford became attached to Mary, whose charm made him feel at peace. Alongside his fellow retainer Tarkus, Bruford passed the trial of the 77 Rings in 1563, becoming two of the only five in history to complete it.
characters.personality: When he was alive, Bruford was an honorable knight of Mary Stuart. His feelings toward her surpassed even that of love. When Elizabeth I betrayed Mary Stuart, Bruford stood by her side, fighting off all of Elizabeth's forces. Upon learning of her capture, he was easily willing to die for her. However, when the executioner showed him Mary Stuart's head, even though he accepted execution to save his liege, he flew into a blind rage and began to resent humanity.

characters.title: Cabbage and Stark
characters.name_ja:
キャベッジ
スターク
characters.bio: Cabbage and Stark are tertiary antagonists featured in the first part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, Phantom Blood.
characters.personality: Cabbage and Stark are cruel and aggressive bullies who pick on others, finding pleasure in the distress of their victims. They enjoy seeing Erina cry, laughing and cheering amongst themselves while mocking her. Their motives for harassing Erina and Jonathan are simply because the two are from wealthy families. Cabbage hates rich people, but admits that he has no particular reason as to why. Cabbage and Stark's resentment for the rich leads them to admire Dio Brando, showing that they are inclined to follow a leader who is stronger and more assertive than them.
characters.ja_kanji:

スターク

characters.title: Caesar Anthonio Zeppeli
characters.name_ja: シーザー・アントニオ・ツェペリ
characters.bio: Caesar Anthonio Zeppeli is a primary ally featured in the second part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, Battle Tendency.
characters.background: Caesar Zeppeli was born on May 13, 1918 in Genoa, Italy, but later lived in Naples with his family. As a child, Caesar idolized his father, Mario Zeppeli. When he was 10, however, his father left him and his siblings with no explanation or warning. As a result, Caesar grew to hate his father, thinking he was out living a new and carefree life without them. His mother had passed away years prior for unknown reasons, and relatives soon stole everything left from his now-orphaned family. Although the family's neighbors took care of Caesar's family, Caesar himself became a violent youth who had to be sent to the orphanage. Due to the poor state of orphanages in the 30's, it is said that his life
characters.personality: Caesar Zeppeli is a hot-blooded but focused man, dedicated to the fight against the Pillar Men.

characters.title: Caineghis
characters.bio: Caineghis the One-Eyed Man is a tertiary character featured in the first part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, Phantom Blood.
characters.background: In 1408, Caineghis is the third knight to survive and successfully complete the challenge of the 77 Rings. He goes down in history as a legendary knight alongside Winzaleo, Eijkman, Bruford, and Tarkus.
characters.personality: His personality in the manga is unknown, as he was only mentioned. In the video game, Caineghis tends to be in a hunched over posture while fighting. He is described in the game's Profile Mode as a knight who, contrary to his position, prefers to use the most underhanded solutions possible due to his perverse personality. Based on his quotes, he seems to be sadistic.

characters.title: Captain Valentine
characters.name_ja: キャプテンヴァレンタイン
characters.bio: Captain Valentine is a tertiary character featured in the seventh part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, Steel Ball Run.
characters.background: Valentine became a captain in the U.S army's cavalry and befriended Funny's father at some point. Later, while visiting his grave, he finds his and sets out to hand it to his son.
characters.personality: Valentine was close friends with Funny's father, and held onto his handkerchief until he could pass it down to his son, in reverence to his sacrifice. He considers patriotism to be the most beautiful virtue in the world, instilling it in Funny as a child and serving as a captain of the army's cavalry.
characters.ja_kanji: キャプテンヴァレンタイン

characters.title: Chérie Polnareff
characters.name_ja: シェリー・ポルナレフ
characters.bio: Chérie Polnareff is a posthumous tertiary character featured in the third part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, Stardust Crusaders.
characters.personality: Although Chérie's personality is mostly unknown, the anime slightly expands on her by adding more flashbacks. She is shown to be caring and adores her older brother. It has been implied that she (at least, her fake by Judgement) can have her feelings easily hurt, as when Polnareff lashes out in anger and says he hates her, she seems very upset.
characters.ja_kanji: シェリー・ポルナレフ

characters.title: Corrupt Lawyer
characters.bio: The Corrupt Lawyer is an unnamed tertiary antagonist featured in the sixth part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, Stone Ocean. He is Jolyne Cujoh's corrupt defense attorney, who first meets with her in the detention center. After the trial, he is revealed to have been bribed by Romeo Jisso's father and acting under Johngalli A.'s orders.
characters.personality: This unnamed lawyer acts noble in front of Jolyne and expresses regret for not being able to lessen her punishment, but is later revealed to have been feigning compassion, having had no true interest in seeing her free.

characters.title: Curly-Haired Prisoner
characters.bio: The Curly-Haired Prisoner is an unnamed tertiary character featured in the sixth part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, Stone Ocean.
characters.personality: The convict seems to have somewhat of a rude personality, pushing Jolyne away from using the prison phone to call her mom, chalking it up to having phone reservations as one of the "Seven wonders of Green Dolphin Street Prison".

characters.title: Danny
characters.bio: Danny is a tertiary ally featured in the first part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, Phantom Blood.
characters.background: George Joestar I bought Danny when he was a puppy when Jonathan was five years old. Danny was very afraid of unfamiliar places and strange people causing him to bite Jonathan when the young boy first approached him. For a while, Jonathan also antagonized Danny by throwing stones at him. One day, while swimming in a river, Jonathan started drowning and was saved by Danny, which made them the best of friends.
characters.personality: Danny is a friendly, active, and intelligent dog. He and Jonathan share an inseparable bond, frequently playing and training together.

characters.title: Danny (Steel Ball Run)
characters.bio: Danny is a tertiary character featured in the seventh part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, Steel Ball Run.
characters.background: Danny was a pet mouse kept by Johnny Joestar when he was around nine years old in 1881 while living in England. His father, George Joestar, only allowed Johnny to keep Danny if he was inside a cage at all times. During a family dinner, Johnny secretly fed Danny scraps of meat under the table, hiding Danny in his jacket's pocket. George caught Johnny and was furious that he brought a rodent to the table, citing it as poor manners for a Joestar. For breaking their promise, George ordered Johnny to take the mouse out to the garden and drown it in the pond.
characters.personality: Danny displays calm and docile behavior, showing no resistance when handled by Johnny Joestar. He contentedly stays inside Johnny's jacket pocket during dinner and eats scraps of meat Johnny secretly drops for him. He was possibly attached to Johnny, as Johnny believes that Danny came back to their house after Johnny released him into the forest.

characters.title: Dario (Steel Ball Run)
characters.bio: Dario is a tertiary character featured in the seventh part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, Steel Ball Run.
characters.background: In 1870, Dario was living in an impoverished village in rural England. He was already displeased with the miserable conditions of his life when his wife, then about 16 or 17 years old, gave birth to a baby boy. Believing themselves too poor to be able to care for the child, they carried the newborn into the mountains to bury him. Dario dug a grave, placed the baby inside, and filled the hole with dirt himself while his wife stood by.
characters.personality: Dario is cruel and callous, showing no remorse for infanticide and leaving his family for dead. Although both parents had apparently made the decision together to bury their newborn baby, it can be assumed that it was mainly at Dario's insistence, based on his cruel personality and the fact that he took the most active role in the burial. Prone to flying into a rage, his abusive nature is apparent when he beats his wife for suggesting that his alcoholism is contributing to their poverty. A man void of any sense of responsibility, he sees his wife and child as nothing more than a burden, overjoyed at the prospect of getting rid of them both.

characters.title: Dario Brando
characters.bio: Dario Brando is a secondary character featured in the first part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, Phantom Blood.
characters.personality: Dario Brando is portrayed as a corrupt, alcoholic, and abusive father.

characters.title: Diamotch Salesman
characters.bio: An unnamed watch salesman who appears as a tertiary antagonist featured in the ninth part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, The JOJOLands.
characters.personality: The watch salesman is initially introduced as a warm and welcoming host, politely welcoming Dragona and Usagi and offering to showcase them a selection of high-class watches. The clerk demonstrates a sales acumen, seizing opportunities to upsell and elaborately describe the exclusivity and value of the store's items. He only starts to take a keen interest in the pair after he notices a large diamond in Dragona's possession. He leads them to a private room in the back and goes above and beyond by offering to serve them beverages and alcohol to please them.

characters.title: Diavolo's Mother
characters.bio: Diavolo's Mother is an unnamed tertiary character featured in the fifth part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, Vento Aureo. She is referred to as Prisoner 696 in the anime.
characters.personality: Not much is known about her personality, but she doesn't seem to be a moral person as she attempted to rob a bank. She insists that the father of her child already died two years ago.

characters.title: Diego's Mother
characters.name_ja:
ディエゴ・ブランドーの母
ブランドー
characters.bio: Diego Brando's Mother, surname Brando, is a posthumous tertiary character featured in the seventh part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, Steel Ball Run.
characters.personality: Although she buried her infant son alive, Diego's mother quickly changes her mind and dedicates herself entirely to his well-being afterward. Despite living in poverty, she makes it a point to teach her son pride and seeks to keep her dignity. She makes any sacrifices to raise Diego, going as far as burning her own hands with hot soup on a daily basis for a month when they didn't have cups.

characters.title: Dio Brando
characters.bio: He is also the protagonist of the light novel OVER HEAVEN, the main antagonist of JORGE JOESTAR, and a postmortem primary antagonist in the spin-off manga Crazy Diamond's Demonic Heartbreak.
characters.personality: Dio is consistently manipulative and violently domineering, and has repeatedly shown a lack of conscience and empathy. He is described by Hirohiko Araki as essentially being a parasite, concealing his true nature to infiltrate the Joestar family, and taking everything he can while plotting a takeover.
characters.residence:
DIO's Mansion, Cairo, Egypt
Windknight's Lot, London, England 
Joestar Mansion, Liverpool, England 
Brando House, London, England

characters.title: Dio's Mother
characters.bio: Dio's Mother is an unnamed posthumous tertiary character featured in the first part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, Phantom Blood.
characters.personality: Dio Brando's mother is a noble, proud, pure, and righteous person. She expresses kindness to almost everyone around her. Despite her dire circumstances, she often goes out of her way to help those in need, often to her own detriment. She is principled; above all else she values doing noble and selfless deeds, as she believes that such way of living leads to heaven. This idea is central to her worldview, seemingly influencing most of her decisions.

characters.title: Dire
characters.bio: Dire is a secondary ally featured in the first part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, Phantom Blood.
characters.background: Dire was a good friend of Will Anthonio Zeppeli, who trained with him and Straizo to be Ripple masters under Tonpetty. When Tonpetty received a letter from Zeppeli revealing the location of the Stone Mask, Dire travelled to Windknight's Lot with his master and Straizo.
characters.personality: Dire is portrayed as a fierce but honorable Ripple user and fighter. Upon meeting Jonathan, he tests Jonathan's fighting ability at countering an imperfect Thunder Split Attack, and later asks Jonathan that he lets him fight Dio one on one to avenge his friend Will Anthonio Zeppeli. Even in death, Dire is determined, taunting Dio one last time by sending a Ripple-infused rose into the vampire's eye.

characters.title: Do Do Do, De Da Da Da
characters.name_en: Do Do Do, De Da Da Da
characters.name_ja: ドゥードゥードゥー・デ・ダーダーダー
characters.bio: Do Do Do, De Da Da Da is a tertiary antagonist featured in the eighth part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, JoJolion, specifically in the "" story arc.
characters.background: Do Do Do, De Da Da Da belongs to a certain undiscovered carnivorous insect species. It is a Rock Insect acquired by Toru and the Locacaca Organization at some point. For unknown reasons, the insects infested the pear orchard of Rai Mamezuku's father with asbestos when Mamezuku was young. Mamezuku witnessed one of the bugs, so his father investigated. This act of unintentionally pursuing the hospital director who planned the attack led to Mamezuku's father getting caught in the flow of calamity, causing him to die from a landslide.
characters.personality: Do Do Do, De Da Da Da is an invasive carnivorous insect, described by Wonder of U as a hunter from the mountains. It preys on and eats small and medium-sized animals like rabbits and birds by assimilating into rocks and sand on the Earth's surface. However, sometimes it also hunts deer and other large animals. It shows loyalty to Wonder of U as it obeys its commands.
characters.ja_kanji: ドゥードゥードゥー・デ・ダーダーダー
namesakes: De Do Do Do, De Da Da Da

characters.title: Doctor Roberts
characters.bio: Doctor Roberts is a tertiary ally featured in the ninth part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, The JOJOLands.
characters.background: Doctor Roberts is the long-term general practitioner for Meryl Mei Qi. At some point, Roberts had his medical license revoked, though he continued practicing medicine as an underground doctor.
characters.personality: Doctor Roberts is a cautious and pragmatic physician who prefers to remain detached from matters outside his medical work. He generally behaves professionally and focuses on treating his patients rather than questioning the circumstances surrounding their injuries.

characters.title: Donatella Una
characters.bio: Donatella Una is a tertiary character featured in the fifth part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, Vento Aureo. She is the late mother of Trish Una and the Boss's former lover.
characters.background: In 1985, Donatella met a young man named Solid Naso at, while she was on vacation in Sardinia. They became lovers but Solid Naso suddenly disappeared without warning or trace. She subsequently gave birth to Trish and both lived in a small room for the next 15 years. Around January 2001, Donatella fell ill and sought to find the father of her only daughter. This caused the Boss to become aware of his daughter's existence, starting a struggle between Passione loyalists and the rogue La Squadra Esecuzioni to find Trish Una. Donatella died in a hospital in Calabria two months before Team Bucciarati were tasked with protecting her daughter.
characters.personality: In the anime, she lists the things she likes and hates while speaking to Diavolo in a flashback. Her preferences are similar to Trish's. She likes frogs and water, but hates bugs, guys who smell, and anything that isn't beautiful. She appears to be caring and sociable, as she introduces herself to "Solid Naso" after seeing a truck almost hit him. Trish also thinks fondly of her.

characters.title: Donovan
characters.bio: Donovan is a tertiary antagonist featured in the second part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, Battle Tendency.
characters.personality: Donovan is a sadistic and conceited Nazi soldier. He is confident about his abilities and looks down on those younger than him. He specializes in torture, claiming that he would drain Joseph's blood without killing him. After assuming he is victorious, Donovan mocks Joseph, demanding that Joseph says that Donovan was right about their gap in strength.

characters.title: Doobie
characters.bio: Doobie the Monster is a tertiary antagonist featured in the first part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, Phantom Blood.
characters.personality: Doobie is animalistic and vicious. As soon as Dio introduces Doobie to Poco's sister, he immediately acts on his urges and pounces at her, ripping her skirt off. In his brief appearance, he speaks primitively, mostly screeching or repeating his words.

characters.title: Doremifasolati Do
characters.name_ja: ドレミファソラティ・ド
characters.bio: Doremifasolati Do is a secondary antagonist featured in the eighth part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, JoJolion, specifically in the "" story arc.
characters.personality: Doremifasolati Do displays a very low level of intelligence and doesn't exhibit any notable personality traits. It follows Urban Guerrilla and protects him from harm, implying a sense of loyalty and basic intelligence.
characters.ja_kanji: ドレミファソラティ・ド

characters.title: Dot Han
characters.bio: Dot Han is a tertiary character featured in the seventh part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, Steel Ball Run.
characters.personality: Almost nothing is disclosed about Dot Han's character, though he shows early confidence in his racing skill. When caught in the effects of In a Silent Way, he reacts with confusion and horror, asking Johnny Joestar and Gyro Zeppeli to help him.

characters.title: Dragona's Bully
characters.bio: An unnamed girl who appears as a tertiary antagonist featured in the ninth part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, The JOJOLands.
characters.personality: The girl initially presents herself as kind and caring to Dragona, offering encouragement and support during gym class. However, this facade quickly fades after Dragona accidentally hits her face with a volleyball, revealing her violent personality and deep-seated hatred toward Dragona.

characters.title: Eijkman
characters.bio: Eijkman the Lightning Knight is a tertiary character featured in the first part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, Phantom Blood.
characters.background: In 1389, Eijkman is the second knight to survive and successfully complete the challenge of the 77 Rings. He goes down in history as a legendary knight alongside Winzaleo, Caineghis, Bruford, and Tarkus.
characters.personality: His personality in the manga is unknown, as he was only mentioned. In the video game, he is particularly loyal to Dio Brando, who revived him. He has voice clips stating that everything is for his lord Dio's sake. Eijkman is described in the game's Profile Mode as a knight who, true to his name, is known for his shining spears and quick movements.

characters.title: Eldis
characters.bio: Eldis is a tertiary character featured in the sixth part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, Stone Ocean.
characters.background: After killing Ermes Costello, Enrico Pucci uses Made in Heaven's ability to accelerate time until the universe reaches a new beginning. Pucci explains that, once a person dies, their soul can never be reborn into the new world. However, during the following acceleration of time, Emporio Alnino defeats Pucci before the universe's cycle can be completed, which alters fate's course in the next cycle of the universe. Thus, the souls of Anasui, Jolyne, Jotaro, and their deceased allies are reborn, albeit with different memories. In this universe, Eldis never had lost her sister nor spent time as a convict.
characters.personality: Though she only appears briefly, Eldis seems to be just as crass as her original counterpart but without her harsh background as she wasn't imprisoned. She mentions her sister telling her never to ride with strangers in response to Anakiss and Irene's offer of a ride.

characters.title: Elizabeth I
characters.bio: Elizabeth I is a tertiary character featured in the first part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, Phantom Blood.
characters.personality: Elizabeth is a scheming woman and an opportunist who uses Darnley's death to her advantage. She doesn't hesitate to lie and murder her relative, Mary Stuart, to ascertain her claim over the throne. As she cannot defeat Tarkus and Bruford's armies, she uses deceitful tactics to execute them: she orders a woman to impersonate the imprisoned Mary after her execution, then demands the two knights' surrender in exchange for Mary's freedom.

characters.title: Erina Pendleton
characters.bio: Erina is introduced as a young girl from Jonathan Joestar's hometown, becoming his love interest after he protects her from two bullies. She grows up to become an active nurse in India, eventually returning home to aid in Jonathan's recovery and marrying him shortly afterward.
characters.background: After the ship's explosion in 1889, the coffin that Erina was hiding in landed into the ocean. Erina opened the lid of the box to check if there was anyone floating in the water that she could save, when she saw a hand attempt to grab her arm from under the box. As she attempted to close the lid, Erina saw Dio's terrifying face floating on the water. Dio had escaped from Jonathan's grip as the explosion hit and stolen his body. He then impaled Jonathan's feet on a stick of wood embedded on the side of the box, allowing him to travel together with the coffin. When Erina opened the lid, Dio managed to grab Lisa Lisa out of the coffin and cradled the baby by his chest, using her as a hostage. D
characters.personality: Raised in Victorian England, Erina is a very sweet, caring young woman who is every bit the proper lady. Though polite and gentle in her youth, Erina did show some strength of character: after having her first kiss stolen by Dio Brando she proceeded to wash her mouth without care that the water was from the gutter as an effort to lessen her shame. Nonetheless, she can also have a commanding presence if she wishes. For instance, Speedwagon noted when first meeting her that her eyes were icy cold, making it clear she did not want her treatment of Jonathan to be interrupted.
characters.residence:
Erina's House, New York City, USA 
England 
India

characters.title: Esidisi
characters.bio: Esidisi is a primary antagonist featured in the second part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, Battle Tendency. He is the second highest ranked Pillar Man after Kars and battles the Ripple users for the possession of the Red Stone of Aja.
characters.background: Esidisi is a member of an ancient tribe that predates human history. One of the few to not object to Kars's ideals, he was spared from their clan's genocide and became Kars's right-hand man. Esidisi accompanied Kars to the Old World to find a flawless Red Stone of Aja, briefly ending up in China, where he learned of Sun Tzu, before his group's search brought them to Rome. There, the Pillar Men battled Ripple users before entering a hibernation state under the Roman Colosseum. The wall that Esidisi and the others embedded themselves in was booby trapped to impale potential prey for nourishment as seen with Mario Zeppeli. At some point, the Nazi learn of the "Pillar Men" and made attempts to s
characters.personality: Like Wamuu and Kars, Esidisi is a confident and violent Pillar Man.
characters.residence:
Colosseum Cavern, Rome, Italy 
Pillar Men Settlement

characters.title: Father Styx
characters.bio: Father Styx is a tertiary character featured in the first part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, Phantom Blood.
characters.personality: Styx is an individual who is respected by his fellow priests as they have high hopes for his missionary trip. However, in reality, he doesn't want to travel for them, and seems more motivated by money than spirituality. While he's alone and intoxicated on the ship while drinking, he complains that God often sends him to nasty places, which suggests that he is xenophobic.

characters.title: Formaggio's Cat
characters.bio: Formaggio's Cat is an unnamed tertiary character featured in the fifth part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, Vento Aureo. It is also a primary ally in the short story "Il Gatto Randagio Se Ne Va con il Vento di Primavera" included in the novel I Testamenti Cremisi.
characters.background: This stray cat was theorized by Illuso to possibly have been part of a gang of cats. One night, Formaggio and Illuso hear voices coming from a narrow alley packed between cheap apartment buildings and restaurants. It leads to a vacant lot that is roughly 130 square meters in size, where they find this cat injured and left for dead by the other strays. Formaggio saves the cat and brings it back to his hideout.
characters.personality: The cat has a rebellious nature and doesn't get close to Formaggio. It is visibly distressed when he carries it in his lap and tries to scratch his face.

characters.title: Fritz von Stroheim
characters.bio: Fritz von Stroheim is a tertiary antagonist featured in the seventh part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, Steel Ball Run.
characters.personality: From Stroheim's short appearance, he is shown to be a cold individual. During his confrontation with Gyro and Johnny, he doesn't hesitate to immediately begin shooting at the duo. Stroheim even threatens to shoot Johnny and Valkyrie if Gyro didn't disarm himself. Johnny later deduced that Stroheim's attack on them was an attempt to steal their left arm corpse part.

characters.title: Gaucho
characters.bio: Gaucho is a tertiary character featured in the seventh part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, Steel Ball Run.
characters.background: Born in Mexico, Gaucho eventually joined the Steel Ball Run with his 6-year-old Criollo horse, Peg.
characters.personality: Not much is known about Gaucho's personality. After getting lost in the forest, he repeatedly asks Ringo Roadagain for the way out, only to be told each time that he will find it after killing Ringo. After many escape attempts, Gaucho snaps. He is visibly upset and ready to shoot Ringo at any moment.

characters.title: George Joestar I
characters.name_ja: ジョージ・ジョースターⅠ世
characters.bio: George Joestar I is a secondary ally featured in the first part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, Phantom Blood.
characters.background: In the 1860s, George and his fiancée Mary have a pair of rings made by a famous jeweler for their engagement. The couple have a son named Jonathan Joestar on April 4, 1868. Shortly after Jonathan's birth, the family goes on a trip where George comes across the Stone Mask in the possession of an art dealer in London. George takes a liking to it and Mary buys it for him.
characters.personality: George Joestar I is a man of the upper class, a true British ‘noble’ who raises both of his sons to the highest standard of etiquette and manners expected of their household. He was exceptionally harsh towards Jonathan as a child for his ‘boorish’ attitude and lack of grace compared to Dio. Despite George’s overbearingly strict nature he loved his sons equally. In his old age George prides both of his boys on their upbringing and academic success.
characters.ja_kanji: ジョージ・ジョースターⅠ世

characters.title: George Joestar II
characters.name_ja: ジョージ・ジョースターⅡ世
characters.bio: George Joestar II is a posthumous tertiary character featured in the second part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, Battle Tendency.
characters.personality: Not much is known about George before his death. However, he had displayed courage and bravery when he attempted to confront his zombie superior until he was eventually caught and killed.
characters.ja_kanji: ジョージ・ジョースターⅡ世

characters.title: George Joestar II (Steel Ball Run)
characters.name_ja: ジョージ・ジョースターⅡ世
characters.bio: George Joestar II is a tertiary character featured in the seventh part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, Steel Ball Run.
characters.background: George Joestar II was born in a family with ties to the aristocracy which fell on hard times. However, George himself was famous and rich as a horse racer and then breeder, having won the seven times and owning several farms with the facilities to breed racing horses. Although he settled in Danville, Kentucky, he made journeys to England with his family.
characters.personality:
with his demands|right
George is an acclaimed horse trainer. He is a strict father, not only forbidding a young Johnny from bringing an adopted mouse to the table while they're eating, but then ordering that the mouse is shown to him and then drowned. Since he is mindful of his reputation among the British, George is particularly severe when it comes to gentlemanly manners.
characters.ja_kanji: ジョージ・ジョースターⅡ世

characters.title: George Joestar III
characters.name_ja: ジョージ・ジョースターⅢ世
characters.bio: George Joestar III is a tertiary character featured in the eighth part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, JoJolion.
characters.background: George Joestar III was born in 1898 as the second child and firstborn son of Johnny Joestar and Rina Joestar, after his unnamed older sister.
characters.personality: Due to his brief appearance, little is known about George's personality. As a child, he is shown to be innocent and affectionate, hugging his mother after Johnny's death. He is also deeply loved by both of his parents, with Johnny sacrificing his own life to save him and Rina anxiously asking about his whereabouts upon returning home.
characters.ja_kanji: ジョージ・ジョースターⅢ世

characters.title: Ghost Rider in the Sky
characters.name_ja: ゴースト・ライダー・イン・ザ・スカイ
characters.bio: Ghost Rider in the Sky is a tertiary ally featured in the seventh part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, Steel Ball Run, and a primary ally in the light novel Lonesome Tim.
characters.personality: Ghost Rider in the Sky is an incredibly intelligent, calm, and deeply loyal horse. Mountain Tim notes that the two of them share a profound bond and that their "hearts are connected," allowing the horse to move with such grace and quietness that its footsteps can barely be heard.
characters.ja_kanji: ゴースト・ライダー・イン・ザ・スカイ

characters.title: Giorno's Mother
characters.bio: Giorno's Mother is an unnamed tertiary character featured in the fifth part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, Vento Aureo.
characters.personality: Although she was considered a very beautiful woman, she was by no means a good mother, having left her infant son alone in the middle of the night to enjoy partying. She valued her "freedom" and was not willing to stay home with her son, wanting to live her life as she did before he was born. It is unknown if she was aware of her husband beating Giorno, but it is noted he only did so while she was not around.

characters.title: Gloria Costello
characters.bio: Gloria Costello is a posthumous tertiary character featured in the sixth part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, Stone Ocean.
characters.personality: Gloria is a strong-willed and selfless woman who inherits her father's restaurant and works with a steady number of customers. Gloria acts motherly to Ermes, who she would regularly lecture and nag to work. She has no intention of marrying anyone.

characters.title: Greenberg
characters.bio: Greenberg is a tertiary character mentioned in the second part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, Battle Tendency. He is also a posthumous tertiary ally in El Aleph.
characters.personality: Greenberg is a talented and dedicated man, experienced at his craft to the point of being a featured screenwriter in Hollywood. His personality is mostly unknown, as he is only mentioned in Battle Tendency and El Aleph.

characters.title: Gregorio Zeppeli
characters.name_ja: グレゴリオ・ツェペリ
characters.bio: Gregorio Zeppeli is a tertiary character featured in the seventh part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, Steel Ball Run.
characters.personality: Gregorio Zeppeli is a somber and serious man, whose loyalty lies in his king and his family.
characters.ja_kanji: グレゴリオ・ツェペリ

characters.title: Gyro's Mother
characters.bio: Gyro's Mother is an unnamed tertiary character featured in the seventh part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, Steel Ball Run.
characters.background:
Gyro's Mother married Gregorio Zeppeli and gave birth to Gyro in 1866. She would later have 4 more children in an unknown year. 
When her husband is summoned by the king's servant once or twice a month, she silently prepares a small meal, which consisted of fish, a loaf of bread and wine.
When Gyro turned 13, his mother kissed him in silence before he went with his father to the castle to fulfill the work of royal executioner.
characters.personality:
Gyro's Mother is attentive and caring to her family, cooking the meal and caring a lot for them, as shown when she kisses Gyro's cheek before he became his father's assistant as an executioner. 
She doesn't have much medical expertise nor the ability to use Steel Balls, but she assists Gyro and her husband with their patients as a nurse. Like her husband, she tells Gyro to focus on the tasks he's assigned to rather than get himself involved with other matters.

characters.title: Hacca's Grandfather
characters.bio: Hacca's Grandfather is an unnamed tertiary character featured in the ninth part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, The JOJOLands. His last name is Howler and his first name is unknown, but it is implied to be based on the letter "F" due to the Howler family's naming scheme.
characters.personality: Howler is portrayed as a patriarch who deeply values his family's legacy and ancestral land. He has a strong sense of personal honor, willing to take extreme measures to protect what he believes belongs to his family. After assassinating Monte Brutto, he also murders the man's driver so that there would be no witnesses to his crime, though he apologizes for having to do so.

characters.title: Hair Clip
characters.bio: An unnamed Hair Clip appears as a tertiary antagonist featured in the eighth part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, JoJolion.
characters.background: One Sunday in the autumn of 2005, Yasuho Hirose visits the flea market in Kotodai Park and thinks the hair clip is really pretty. According to the vendor, the hair clip was made in China during the era of of Qing. There was later a war and a Taiwanese girl owned it. The man sells it to Yasuho for 7,800 yen, which she considers cheap as she believes the hair clip to be authentic.
characters.personality: It imitates jewelry in order to get closer to the heads of humans. It enjoys fooling and manipulating those with weak hearts and licks their skin dandruff. The creature makes a "GYGYGYGYYYYY" sound whenever it feels victorious.

characters.title: Holy Joestar-Kira
characters.name_ja: 吉良・ホリー・ジョースター
stand_names: List of Unnamed Stands#Holy Joestar-Kira's Stand
characters.bio: Holy Joestar-Kira is a secondary ally featured in the eighth part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, JoJolion. She is introduced in the ""Paisley Park" and "Born This Way"" story arc.
characters.background: Born Holy Joestar, she is the daughter of Joseph Joestar and Suzi Q. She is also the mother of, making this Kira a direct descendant of Johnny Joestar. Holy Joestar-Kira is revealed to have been an ophthalmologist who worked at the T.H. Medical University Hospital from 1998-2008 before becoming a guest professor at TG University.
characters.personality: Holy suffers from an unknown type of mental disorder that makes her mistake people for objects, for instance, mistake a nurse for a pair of shoes. This is explained by the fact that parts of her brain are missing, although it is then revealed that she was the subject of inhuman trials conducted by the Locacaca Organization, who turned parts of her into rock. While under medical care, she can interact normally, capable of addressing Yasuho as another human being although she exhibits difficulties in reacting to what her interlocutor says. For instance, she ignores for a moment the fact that Yasuho came to inquire about her son.
characters.ja_kanji: 吉良・ホリー・ジョースター

characters.title: Holy Kujo
characters.name_ja: 空条 ホリィ (空条 聖子)
characters.bio: Holy Kujo, née Joestar, is a secondary ally featured in the third part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, Stardust Crusaders. She is the daughter of Joseph Joestar and Suzi Q, wife of Sadao Kujo, and mother of Jotaro Kujo.
characters.background: Holy is the daughter of Joseph Joestar and Suzi Q, born in 1942.
characters.personality: Holy is the cheerful, doting mother of her son Jotaro Kujo, hardly ever seen without a smile. Despite her son's common insults and general annoyance at her, she's able to see through him and perceive the true kindness within him, of which she is deeply proud. She loves her family with all her heart and will even lie about her own well-being to keep them from worrying about her. In general, she is a caring person, showing concern for a wounded Kakyoin, taking time to care for his wounds. Kakyoin feels inspired by her, describing her as ‘someone who just puts you at ease by being near her’.

characters.title: Honolulu Police Officers
characters.bio: Two unnamed officers from the are tertiary antagonists featured in the ninth part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, The JOJOLands.
characters.personality: The two Honolulu police officers are immoral, lack integrity, and have superiority complexes. The one with light-colored hair disregards the concerns of the individuals he's interrogating. He uses his authority to intimidate and manipulate situations to his advantage. For example, when Dragona doesn't want the officer's face to get too close because of health concerns of, the officer twists the situation to be an attack on his race because of his fair skin in contrast to Dragona's dark skin. He is extremely perverted, using his routine procedure to pull over vehicles if they suspect unlawful behavior as a pretext for inappropriate behavior. He's quick to impose accusations without substanti

characters.title: Inspector Archer
characters.bio: Inspector Archer is a tertiary ally featured in the first part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, Phantom Blood.
characters.background: In 1868, having just started working in Scotland Yard's police force, a young Archer arrests Dario Brando as his first accomplishment. Dario had been found trying to pawn off a ring containing a valuable jewel set in platinum. Realizing it was made by a famous jeweler, the police officers visit the jeweler, who remembered making it for George Joestar I. Mary Joestar had given that ring to George, and Dario stole it from George after the couple's carriage accident.
characters.personality: Archer is an emotional police officer, caring a lot for George. In his past, when he first became a police officer, he felt exhilarated to recover such an important and valuable item as George's ring. He is polite to nobles like George but is honest enough to tell George that he's being too naive by forgiving Dario Brando. He scorns criminals like Dario, believing that people like him cannot change.

characters.title: Irene
characters.bio: Irene is a tertiary character featured in the sixth part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, Stone Ocean.
characters.background: After killing Jolyne Cujoh, Pucci uses Made in Heaven's ability to accelerate time until the universe reaches a new beginning. Suddenly transported back to the prison, Emporio looks for Jolyne again only to find a doppelgänger in her place. Pucci explains that this is because once a person dies, their soul can never be reborn into the new world. However, during the following acceleration of time, Emporio Alnino defeats Pucci before the universe's cycle can be completed, which alters fate's course in the next cycle of the universe. Thus, the souls of Anasui, Jolyne, Jotaro, and their deceased allies are reborn, albeit living different lives with different memories.
characters.personality: In her brief introduction, Irene appears to be friendly and rather carefree, having offered a ride she shares with her boyfriend, Anakiss, to multiple strangers (Emporio and Eldis); along with asking Anakiss to give a hitchhiker a ride despite his objections.

characters.title: Iwasuke
characters.bio: Iwasuke is a tertiary character featured in the eighth part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, JoJolion.
characters.background: At the time of the earthquake in Morioh, Iwasuke eats the Locacaca fruit left behind by Josefumi Kujo and smiles from the taste before walking away.
characters.personality: Iwasuke is an obedient pet and easily forms an attachment to his owner, Tsurugi Higashikata. True to his curious tendencies as a stray animal, he primarily roamed around the springs at the area of the Morioh Wall Eyes and the Higashikata estate, which ultimately led him to eat a Locacaca fruit at some point during the Morioh earthquake. In spite of this, he easily became loyal to Tsurugi after he was taken in to live with the Higashikata Family in their home.

characters.title: Jack the Ripper
characters.bio: Jack the Ripper is a secondary antagonist featured in the first part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, Phantom Blood.
characters.personality: Above all else, Jack the Ripper detests women who are enjoying themselves. As such, he takes immense pleasure in his murders of unarmed victims, cutting out their organs with a scalpel and hanging them on nearby walls. However, Jack is also meticulous in his actions, using a gentlemanly facade to seduce his victims until he can safely perform the deed. Unexpected hinderances have been shown to unsettle the killer, and his murderous tendencies can easily be turned toward witnesses to his heinous actions if need be, as seen when he attempts to kill Dio Brando.

characters.title: Jesus Christ
characters.bio: Jesus Christ, usually referred to as The Saint, is a secondary character featured in the seventh part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, Steel Ball Run.
characters.background: Approximately 2000 years in the past, Jesus Christ inspires a new way of faith. However, society deems him too dangerous and sentences him to crucifixion on the hill of.
characters.personality: Jesus is depicted as an enigmatic figure, always obscured by shadow and leaving few words. He expresses gratitude for others and forgiveness. He carries foreseen knowledge of the future and spiritual insight into others. He appears as a messiah, inspiring awe in everyone he meets. Jesus expresses gratitude towards Joseph of Arimathea for maintaining his corpse prior to his resurrection and entrusts him with a map of the undiscovered American continent.

characters.title: Jobin's Bully
characters.bio: An unnamed boy who appears as a tertiary character featured in the eighth part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, JoJolion.
characters.personality: The boy presents himself as a polite and dependable senior member of a children's club when adults are present. He reassures Kaato Higashikata that the children will return safely, speaking with enough confidence and authority to earn her trust. His behavior suggests that he is accustomed to taking charge of the younger members and maintaining a respectable appearance in front of their parents.

characters.title: Jolyne's Mother
characters.bio: Jolyne's Mother is an unnamed tertiary character featured in the sixth part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, Stone Ocean.
characters.background: She met Jotaro at some point and later gave birth to Jolyne around 1992. She has affectionately called her daughter "JoJo" ever since. Living in Florida, Jolyne spent much of her childhood without her father, as his job frequently required him to leave the country. Even when she developed a high fever of 42 °C at age 6, Jotaro did not return from Japan to be with her, which she deeply resented. In truth, Jotaro made sure not to involve his family in the dangerous adventures he lived.
characters.personality: She had a close relationship with her daughter, whom she raised mostly alone due to the absence of her husband. She always called her daughter "JoJo" out of love, a nickname that reflected their affectionate bond.

characters.title: Jonathan Joestar
characters.name_ja: ジョナサン・ジョースター
characters.bio: Jonathan Joestar is the protagonist of the first part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, Phantom Blood, and the first JoJo of the series. His legacy extends throughout almost the entirety of the first six parts of the series, with major characters such as Joseph Joestar and Jotaro Kujo being his descendants.
characters.personality: During his childhood, Jonathan was proud and mischievous, yet gentle. Despite already aspiring to be a "true gentleman", Jonathan lacked manners and mostly behaved like a normal child. His mother, having died before he could remember her, and his fellow boys ostracizing him because of his status left Jonathan somewhat lonely. While at first, Jonathan didn't have his future strength of will, Dio unwittingly became the catalyst of his growth by pushing him to the edge and humiliating his girlfriend Erina Pendleton. However, he did have the kindness and courage to immediately jump to Erina's rescue against two bullies bigger than him despite not knowing her.

characters.title: Joseph Joestar (JoJolion)
characters.name_ja: 仗世文・ジョースター
characters.bio: Joseph Joestar, also known as Fumi, is a tertiary character featured in the eighth part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, JoJolion, specifically in "" story arc.
characters.background: Born Joseph Joestar, he is the son of George Joestar III, and the grandson of Rina Higashikata and Johnny Joestar. He was named by his grandmother Rina who lived with him in S City. His name spelled in Japanese, Josefumi, earned him the nickname "Fumi".
characters.personality: Joseph is a polite teenager who doesn't hesitate to help an elderly woman retrieve her stolen luggage from a thief. He formally refers to Lucy as "madam" before learning her name and cares for her well-being when she starts coughing. His concern for Lucy's health extends as far as traveling back with her to America to make sure she would be okay on her voyage and flight. He is also knowledgeable of Morioh's history and landmarks.

characters.title: Joseph of Arimathea
characters.bio: Joseph of Arimathea is a posthumous tertiary character featured in the seventh part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, Steel Ball Run.
characters.background: Joseph of Arimathea took the body of Jesus Christ down from the cross after his crucifixion and prepared it for burial. Three days later, Joseph witnessed his resurrection. Jesus thanked Joseph but announced that he would be going East. When Joseph asked if he would ever see him again, Jesus simply drew a map of the Americas with nine spots marked with stars before departing.
characters.personality:
's map, Joseph dedicated the rest of his life to preserving it
Joseph of Arimathea is a person with great affection for Jesus Christ, purifying and wrapping his corpse with a blanket in spite of Jesus having already perished. Upon Jesus's revival, Joseph was driven to tears, asking Jesus if he would ever see him again, to which Jesus replies by entrusting him with a map of the undiscovered American continent.

characters.title: Josuke Higashikata (JoJolion)
characters.bio: Josuke Higashikata is the protagonist of the eighth part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, JoJolion, and the eighth JoJo of the series.
characters.personality: Josuke Higashikata is a quirky amnesiac determined to learn his true identity and his past.

characters.title: Josuke's Savior
characters.bio: Josuke's Savior is an unnamed tertiary character featured in the fourth part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, Diamond is Unbreakable.
characters.personality: Based on the boy's appearance in Josuke's flashback, he is an empathetic and perceptive individual. Although it was a dark night, the boy could tell that Josuke was sick in the back of Tomoko's car. He voluntarily helps them move their car out of the snow despite being in a rough state with several fresh bruises and open cuts on his face. He also sacrifices his school jacket, which is considered his badge of honor, underneath the car's tires without any hesitation.

characters.title: Junko
characters.bio: Junko is a tertiary character mentioned in the fourth part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, Diamond is Unbreakable. She is given a full appearance in the spin-off Toshikazu Hazamada's Questionable Adventure.
characters.personality: After Surface copies Junko, Hazamada describes her personality as "a real bitch" and thinking "she's all that". He wanted to force himself on her, but never had the courage to actually do it. In the drama CD, A Ghost Story from Budogaoka High, Surface copies Junko's personality yet again and displays contempt to Hazamada, calling him a creep and doesn't even want him to say her name.

characters.title: Kai Harada
characters.bio: Kai Harada is a tertiary character featured in the anime adaptation of the fourth part of JoJo's Bizarre Adventure, Diamond is Unbreakable.
characters.personality: Kai Harada is an amicable radio show host, referring to himself as the listeners' "neighbor." He listens to and reports on listeners' submitted problems and worries, giving light-hearted commentary on them and inquires about listeners' moods, activities, and plans through rhetorical questions.

characters.title: Kars
characters.bio: Kars is the main antagonist of the second part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, Battle Tendency, as well as the second main antagonist of the series overall.
characters.personality: Kars is intelligent, ruthless, and ambitious in his pursuit to conquer his kind's weakness to the sun. He is stated to have been a genius among his tribe, and the original creator of the Stone Mask.
characters.residence:
Colosseum Cavern, Rome, Italy 
Pillar Men Settlement

characters.title: Kenshiro
characters.part_basis:
其它作品: FotNS: Chapter 1
JJBA: SO Chapter 107
characters.bio: Kenshiro is the protagonist of the Fist of the North Star series, created by and Tetsuo Hara. He is the 64th successor of the deadly martial art Hokuto Shinken, which he uses to protect the weak and oppose those who seek to dominate a post-apocalyptic world.
characters.background: In Fist of the North Star, Kenshiro was originally an orphan from the Land of Asuras in the Republic of China and a descendant of the Hokuto Soke bloodline. He was sent to Japan by a former master named Jukei and was eventually taken in by Ryuken, the 63rd master of Hokuto Shinken. Ryuken named him after his older brother Kenshiro Kasumi, since they shared the same Big Dipper-shaped birthmark on their heads. He trained him alongside his other adoptive sons, Jagi, Toki, and Raoh. Despite being younger and more naive than his older brothers, Kenshiro was a promising student who ultimately earned the title of successor, much to the dismay of Jagi and Raoh.

characters.title: Kidnapped Girl
characters.bio: The unnamed Kidnapped Girl is a tertiary character featured in the eighth part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, JoJolion, specifically in the "Soft & Wet" story arc.
characters.background: According to her, throughout her life, the woman would be used by people around her. Whether it be at school, by her parents or by a boy she liked, she was treated as someone who exists for the convenience of others and would be discarded whenever she's not needed anymore. At one point, she was sightseeing in Morioh when she was kidnapped and branded by Ojiro Sasame against her will. Ojiro planned to use her as bait to get revenge on Yoshikage Kira when he came back to his apartment. Because of this, she was forced to suffer being helplessly locked up in Kira's bathroom, stripped completely nude and terrified for three days. Additionally, in order to frame Kira, Ojiro disguised himself as hi
characters.personality: When Josuke discovers the woman kidnapped by Ojiro in the bathroom, she initially appears unconcerned about her situation, likely mistaking him for her abductee. However, her demeanor drastically changes once she spots Yasuho, desperately begging for them to help her escape. Although not a Stand user herself, she's keenly aware of Ojiro's Stand ability, and thus remains mostly silent to avoid attracting her kidnapper's attention. Despite offering Josuke helpful advice and warning him about Ojiro's attacks, she mostly cowers in the corner and tries to avoid getting herself involved.

characters.title: Kira's Coworker
characters.bio: Kira's Coworker is an unnamed tertiary character featured in the fourth part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, Diamond is Unbreakable.
characters.personality: Kira's coworker has a somewhat rude personality, telling his fellow coworkers to give up on inviting Kira to have lunch, calling him a "total buzzkill" and while he does compliment his hardworking nature, he says that Kira lacks passion and he's just a nobody who fades into the background in life.

characters.title: Kiyomi Kujo
characters.bio: Kiyomi Kujo is a tertiary character featured in the eighth part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, JoJolion.
characters.background: At some point, Kiyomi and Sadafumi Kujo got married and had a son named Josefumi Kujo. When Josefumi was a toddler, she and Sadafumi got divorced. Soon after, this took a heavy toll on her, as Kiyomi would constantly take days off from work, feigning illnesses or headaches, and would do other things instead like go to the beach.
characters.personality: Kiyomi is irresponsible and neglectful toward her son. Instead of going to work, she would take several days off and relax on the beach. She goes as far as taking sleeping pills before calling her workplace to feign sleepiness.

characters.title: Koichi Hirose
characters.bio: Koichi Hirose is a primary ally featured in the fourth part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, Diamond is Unbreakable. He appears briefly as a tertiary ally in the fifth part, Vento Aureo, assisting Giorno Giovanna in the fight against Polpo's Stand, Black Sabbath. Koichi is also the protagonist of the light novel The Book ~jojo's bizarre adventure 4th another day~ and the one-shot Echoes ACT50.
characters.personality: Koichi is an amiable, but meek youth who undergoes an exceptional degree of character development over the course of Diamond is Unbreakable, becoming more assertive throughout many confrontations with evil Stand users. His growth is best represented by the metamorphosis of his Stand, Echoes.

characters.title: Koichi's Mother
characters.bio: Koichi Hirose's Mother is an unnamed tertiary character featured in the fourth part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, Diamond is Unbreakable.
characters.background: After getting married to Koichi's Father, they have their first child, Ayana, in around 1981. In 1984, they have their second child, Koichi. At some point, they adopt a dog into the family named Police.
characters.personality: Koichi's mother is a cheerful, lively woman. She is welcoming to visitors, seen being open to conversation with Tamami and defending him when Koichi rushes in. In general, she is cordial to strangers and gets along with them well.

characters.title: Kosaku Kawajiri
characters.bio: Kosaku Kawajiri is a posthumous tertiary character featured in the fourth part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, Diamond is Unbreakable. Kosaku is an ordinary who is the husband of Shinobu Kawajiri and father of Hayato Kawajiri.
characters.background: Kosaku met Shinobu in community college, although he went to a higher ranking college than her in the same area. She dated him because it made her feel superior to her friends, who thought Kosaku was cool and quiet. At some point she became pregnant with Hayato, obligating them to get married.
characters.personality: According to his wife, Kosaku is an extremely plain and boring man and the only things he would do after coming home from work is eat, shower, and sleep. He seems to be intelligent, as he went to a higher ranked college than Shinobu. She states that he isn't a bad man and he's hard working despite his pitiful salary. He also does not have bad habits like drinking. Shinobu's friends in college thought he was cool and quiet.

characters.title: Kyoka Izumi (The JOJOLands)
characters.bio: Kyoka Izumi is a tertiary character featured in the ninth part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, The JOJOLands.
characters.background: Kyoka works as Rohan Kishibe's manga editor. While Jodio Joestar observes Rohan at his villa in Hawaii, he sees photos of Rohan's dog Bakin on Rohan's tablet and remarks that Rohan's editor might be taking care of the dog while Rohan is traveling.
characters.personality: Kyoka is practical and professionally minded. She is highly dedicated to her work, having traveled from Tokyo to Morioh at night to meet with Rohan. She immediately questions why a minor dialogue correction requires her to travel from Tokyo when the changes could be communicated by email or fax. Nonetheless, she is focused on ensuring that the corrections are completed before the chapter begins distribution and accepts the manuscript despite Rohan's unusual insistence on using only analog methods.

characters.title: Latrato
characters.bio: Latrato is a posthumous tertiary character featured in the ninth part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, The JOJOLands. His first name is unknown, with Latrato being his surname. However, his family name was changed to Howler when the United States annexed Hawaii.
characters.personality: Latrato is an adaptable and persevering individual. After surviving a shipwreck, he quickly integrates with his new environment, falling in love with a local woman and earning the approval of the Hawaiian royal family to start a farm on their land.

characters.background: Laura serves as a Staff Sergeant in the United States Marine Corps on Hawaii Island. She is romantically involved with Master Sergeant Liam Longbeach. Before Longbeach returns from leave, Laura asks him to purchase an adult toy for her and contacts him about when he will return.
characters.personality: Laura strictly follows the security procedures of the military facility even when dealing with someone she knows personally. After recognizing who she believes to be Liam Longbeach, she still requires him to present his luggage for inspection because of the facility's regulations.

characters.title: Leaky-Eye Luca
characters.bio: Leaky-Eye Luca is a tertiary antagonist featured in the fifth part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, Vento Aureo.
characters.personality: Luca is a ruthless and merciless gangster. Luca usually hides behind a masquerade of amiability, citing friendship as one of the most important values. However, he uses the term "friendship" to disguise his will to be obeyed and paid for operations taking place on his territory. Luca is particularly callous and violent, threatening Giorno Giovanna for money and refusing to listen when Giorno adamantly claims to have none. When he sees a frog hop onto Giorno's clothes, he also orders Giorno to kill it, and attempts to bash both when the boy refuses. Narancia Ghirga later comments that, before his death, Luca was generally mean to others and even sold drugs to children.

characters.name_ja: リアム・ロングビーチ

characters.background: Longbeach serves as a Master Sergeant in the United States Marine Corps on Hawaii Island. He is romantically involved with Staff Sergeant Laura Laspezia. Prior to returning from leave, he purchases an adult toy that Laura had privately requested from him. According to Charming Man, he supposedly went on a motorcycle tour to.
characters.personality: Longbeach readily stops to assist someone who appears to be injured. When he encounters the disguised Charming Man lying beside a fallen bicycle on an isolated road, Longbeach pulls over and approaches him, asking whether he fell and if he is alright. He continues checking on Charming Man until he is suddenly attacked.

characters.title: List of Horses
characters.bio: This article contains a list of horses featured in the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series. The majority of these horses participated in the Steel Ball Run race.

characters.title: Locacaca Organization
characters.bio: The Locacaca Organization is a group featured in the eighth part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, JoJolion. The group is the main antagonistic force throughout JoJolion.
characters.background: The organization is largely secretive and not much is known about its formation or history. In 1941, Toru was spotted by Lucy Steel, a Speedwagon Foundation member investigating a new species of plant in Morioh, putting Locacaca plants in a pot before disappearing.

characters.title: Loccobarocco
characters.bio: Loccobarocco is a tertiary character featured in the sixth part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, Stone Ocean.
characters.personality: Loccobarocco prefers lecturing criminals via his alligator puppet, Charlotte. When Loccobarocco is interrupted, Charlotte will angrily yell at whoever interrupted him.

characters.title: Loggins
characters.bio: Loggins is a secondary ally featured in the second part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, Battle Tendency. As one of Lisa Lisa's servants and a fellow Ripple master, he becomes Joseph's personal trainer after he first encounters the Pillar Men.
characters.background: Loggins and his partner Messina were trained in the art of the Ripple by Lisa Lisa, eventually becoming masters in said art, as well as Lisa Lisa's servants.
characters.personality: Loggins displays a very demanding demeanor when instructing Joseph and Caesar, often forcing them to do tough trials during their Ripple training. Despite this, he seems to have, along with Messina, a sense of humor as the two would often tease their disciples.

characters.title: Maako Kitani
characters.bio: Maako Kitani, also known as Makorin, is a tertiary character featured in the eighth part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, JoJolion. She has one daughter and is the girlfriend of Ojiro Sasame.
characters.background: Maako Kitani is a citizen of Morioh. She's had a successful career as a businesswoman as she is the CEO of her own company, "Seiten Holdings". She is also the owner of the local baseball team, the Seiten Birdies. Thanks to her wealth, she has her own condominium. However, she is jealous of the valuable hilly land that belongs to the Higashikata Family. In contrast, Maako's own land is of poorer quality and she had to bend the law to build her stadium. Maako thus maintains a good relationship with Norisuke Higashikata IV in the hopes of acquiring his land one day.
characters.personality: Maako is greedy and selfish, acting sociable and friendly with others to get what she wants. However, she is willing to lavishly spend her money on her boyfriend, oblivious that Ojiro is stealing extra money and taking advantage of her. She is not afraid to bend the law to further her goals. Her condo and stadium were built on top of a weak foundation and she had to bend the law to get a building permit. She is also narcissistic, calling her own hand cute and complaining that Mitsuba insulted her despite Mitsuba only being a housewife.
