characters.title: Malèna
characters.bio: Malèna is a tertiary ally featured in the third part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, Stardust Crusaders.
characters.personality: Malèna is portrayed as a kind, young woman who seems good with children based on how well she took care of Polnareff, despite his tantrums. She seemed genuinely distressed about his disappearance after she is freed from Sethan's de-aging ability.

characters.title: Man X
characters.bio: Man X is a tertiary ally featured in the fifth part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, Vento Aureo.
characters.personality: Man X is a mysterious individual. Giorno feels that Man X is just like him, appearing lonely and melancholic. Despite being a gangster, the man has a strong sense of justice and repays his debts. Although he would keep his distance and only watch Giorno from afar, Man X treats Giorno with respect, ultimately teaching Giorno the importance of trusting people from their silent interactions. He acts somewhat cruelly by not speaking to Giorno, trying to ensure that Giorno doesn't get involved with gangs.

characters.title: Mansaku Nijimura
characters.bio: Mansaku Nijimura, also known as Father Nijimura, is a tertiary character featured in the fourth part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, Diamond is Unbreakable.
characters.background: In 1987, Nijimura's wife passed away from an illness. His business soon failed, leaving his family burdened with massive debt despite Japan being in the midst of a prosperous bubble economy. Desperate for financial stability, Nijimura effectively sold his "heart" to DIO, who was searching the world for people with the talent to possess a Stand to serve as his underlings.
characters.personality: Before his mutation, Mansaku Nijimura was shown to be a man who loved his family. However, he was by no means a good father. He agreed to work for DIO in order to keep his family's economic situation together, but at the same time, he would often beat his sons without a second thought when he was stressed.

characters.title: Marco
characters.bio: Marco is a secondary character featured in the seventh part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, Steel Ball Run.
characters.background: Marco is introduced as a young boy born into a long line of servants who served under Napoleonic aristocrats. At the age of 9, he had been ordered to serve under a baron called Lippi, where his sole job would be to clean his hats and shoes. Before setting out, Marco's father told him that "the job would bring him happiness as long as he stayed humble and earnest". Taking these words to heart, Marco would get up early every morning to shine shoes and brush hats for the baron and his guests.
characters.personality: Marco is a gentle, obedient, and hardworking boy who takes pride in serving others. Raised in a long line of servants, he was taught by his father to find happiness by remaining humble and diligent. Despite being only nine years old, Marco approaches his duties, which involves shining shoes, brushing hats, and performing household tasks, with genuine enthusiasm and a strong sense of responsibility.

characters.title: Mario Zeppeli
characters.name_ja: マリオ ・ ツェペリ
characters.bio: Mario Zeppeli is a posthumous tertiary ally featured in the second part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, Battle Tendency.
characters.personality: Mario Zeppeli is characterized as hard-working, trustworthy, and a wholesome family man. Although he loved his family, Mario had to abandon them in order to investigate the Pillar Men. He was concerned that his son Caesar would follow in his and his father's footsteps if he discovered the truth.
characters.ja_kanji: マリオ ・ ツェペリ

characters.title: Mark
characters.bio: Mark is a tertiary ally featured in the second part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, Battle Tendency.
characters.background: Mark had been good friends with Caesar for a long time. Caesar had introduced him to a girl back in Germany, and she and Mark were planning to get married before the war started.
characters.personality: According to Caesar, Mark is a hardworking boy who loves his family, his country, and his girlfriend. Mark plans to marry his girlfriend before a war could begin, but he is nervous breaking the news to Caesar and momentarily loses focus while driving.

characters.title: Mary Joestar
characters.name_ja: メアリー・ジョースター
characters.bio: Mary Joestar is a posthumous tertiary character appearing in the first part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, Phantom Blood.
characters.ja_kanji: メアリー・ジョースター

characters.title: Mary Stuart
characters.name_ja: メアリー・スチュアート
characters.bio: Mary Stuart is a tertiary character featured in the first part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, Phantom Blood.
characters.personality: Mary is kind and caring, providing respite to the orphaned young knights Bruford and Tarkus. Her peaceful nature made her fit to be queen, as she could easily calm the hearts of the two lonely knights. Regardless of their strength, Mary was capable of giving them hope. Despite Elizabeth accusing her of, Mary's army pledges loyalty to her and fights for her until the end.
characters.ja_kanji: メアリー・スチュアート

characters.title: Mauka
characters.bio: Mauka is a tertiary character featured in the ninth part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, The JOJOLands.
characters.background: Mauka lives with his older brother, Charming Man, on a farm on Hawaii Island. One day, the brothers have an argument near the outskirts of their farm, which someone reports to the police.
characters.personality: Mauka participates in recreational competitions with his older brother. During their bicycle race at Hualalai, he comments on Charming Man's aggressive riding and jokes about his unusual amount of energy, asking whether he plans to compete in an. He also continues racing after Charming Man proposes that they compete in a two-mile swimming race once they reach the beach.

characters.title: Max
characters.bio: Max is a posthumous tertiary character featured in the ninth part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, The JOJOLands.
characters.background: While little is known about Max's history, an apparition of Alison Alohaoe's husband manifested by Point Blank Seal reveals that Alison and Max were close to each other. The apparition implies Alison had been cheating on her husband with Max, and continues to see him after her husband's death. The affair is done in secret, as Usagi confesses he had never heard of Max before the cyber fraud incident.
characters.personality: The real Max's personality is unknown. The apparition of him manifested by Point Blank Seal is crude, vulgar, and openly provocative. When speaking to Usagi Alohaoe, he makes obscene comments about Alison and deliberately insults Usagi in order to provoke him. He appears calm while doing so and repeatedly urges Usagi to look back at him.

characters.title: Merlai Anne
characters.bio: Merlai Anne is a tertiary ally featured in the third part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, Stardust Crusaders.
characters.background: Merlai Anne wanted to travel the world, believing that posing as a boy would make it easier. She believed that once she had grown enough she would need to start wearing a bra, making it difficult to pose as a guy at that point. Shortly before the events of Stardust Crusaders, she runs away from home, believing that the age she is now is the best to travel and that she "has nothing better to do."
characters.personality: Upon meeting the Joestar Group, Anne behaves like a temperamental and irreverent brat. She confidently challenges all five of them with only her small knife and a crazed attitude.

characters.title: Meryl Mei Qi
characters.bio: Meryl Mei Qi is a secondary ally featured in the ninth part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, The JOJOLands.
characters.background: Meryl Mei supposedly has a handsome husband and child at home, though her address is a mystery. She is primarily the principal of McKinley High School. However, she is also the boss of a criminal organization and recruits students from her school to be part of her gang.
characters.personality: Meryl Mei Qi is considered a "superwoman" by Jodio Joestar, leading a triple life as an educator, talented fashion designer, and criminal mastermind. Under her facade as a well-loved and respectable public figure, she is actually a meticulous crime boss. Meryl Mei is publicly known as a high school principal, where she is loved by the students, all of whom gladly salute her and whom she greets in return. She is also the owner of IKO IKO, a fashion boutique in Kalihi. She personally works on many aspects of the boutique, such as designing the clothing, merchandise, and posters; Jodio admires her work and judges that she could be a successful fashion designer even in Paris or Milan if she ever

characters.title: Messina
characters.bio: Messina is a secondary ally featured in the second part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, Battle Tendency. As Lisa Lisa's servants and Ripple masters, he and Loggins train Joseph and Caesar Anthonio Zeppeli in the ways of the Ripple.
characters.background: Messina and his partner Loggins were trained in the art of the Ripple by Lisa Lisa, eventually becoming masters in said art, as well as Lisa Lisa's servants.
characters.personality: Although much of Messina's personality isn't focused upon, he displays the characteristics of a stern, yet effective instructor to Joseph and Caesar. Despite this, Messina seems to have a sense of humor as he, along with Loggins, would often tease his disciples during their training. He takes a likening to Caesar, though he is quite dispararging to JoJo's personality.

characters.title: Minako Okura
characters.bio: Minako Okura is a tertiary character featured in the fourth part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, Diamond is Unbreakable. During an investigation, Hayato Kawajiri witnesses her and her boyfriend Satoru Nakae being killed by Yoshikage Kira.
characters.background: Minako mentions that she would frequently sneak out of the house at night, making her father concerned and prompted into spying on her. Once Minako noticed him, she tried to teach him a lesson by stealing something on purpose just to let him see it. She subsequently ran away from home and moved in with Satoru. Though cut off from her father, she says that she still keeps in contact with her mother.
characters.personality: Minako gives off the impression of a spoiled young woman who doesn't care for the well-being of others. She and her boyfriend, Satoru Nakae, are quick to assume Kira is a thief despite the latter merely pushing Minako's bag off his lap. They are also willing to quickly shift blame onto Kira for bumping into them despite their carelessness being the cause. Minako also seems to be in the habit of sneaking out at night, resulting in her father becoming worried about her.
occupations: S City M Community College First-year student

characters.title: Mrs. Robinson
characters.bio: Mrs. Robinson is a tertiary antagonist featured in the seventh part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, Steel Ball Run.
characters.background: According to Mrs. Robinson, he grew up in a desert village where disputes could escalate into fights to the death. The defeated person would be chained to a cactus and deliberately left to die. The villagers believed that the cactus would curse the deceased, enslaving them even after death so that they could neither take revenge nor continue bearing a grudge.
characters.personality: Mrs. Robinson is a ruthless and highly competitive participant in the Steel Ball Run. Rather than attempting to defeat other competitors solely through racing, he is willing to seriously injure or kill them to prevent them from getting ahead of him. After revealing the secret behind his attacks, he confidently declares that nobody in the race will be allowed to run ahead of him.

characters.bio: The Mukade Shopkeeper is an unnamed tertiary character featured in the fourth part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, Diamond is Unbreakable.
characters.personality: He enjoys eating animal crackers and always saves the camel-shaped ones for last. He appears to be vain to some degree as he states that he has an excellent memory and can remember the name of every one of his customers but is unable to recall the one on Yoshikage Kira's coat. While looking at the name tag on Kira's collar, he has trouble reading the kanji.

characters.title: Nicholas Joestar
characters.name_ja: ニコラス・ジョースター
characters.bio: Nicholas Joestar is a posthumous tertiary character featured in the seventh part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, Steel Ball Run.
characters.personality:
In the past, Nicholas was shown as kind and sympathetic to his much younger brother Johnny.
According to Johnny, Nicholas's teachers trust him enough to lend him a mouse corpse on account of his good grades.

characters.title: Norisuke Higashikata I
characters.name_ja:
ノリスケ・ヒガシカタ
初代 東方 憲助
characters.bio: Norisuke Higashikata I is a tertiary character featured in the seventh part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, Steel Ball Run, and briefly mentioned in the eighth part, JoJolion.
characters.background: Norisuke lived in the. According to Tsurugi Higashikata's explanation of the Higashikata family's superstitious beliefs of warding away "demons of sickness", Norisuke, being the firstborn son of his family, was raised as a girl until age twelve. At some point when he was 68 years old, a report on Norisuke was published in a newspaper for having two navels, considering it one of the oddities of the world. His parents and grandparents only had one navel, and research was being conducted on his navels by several medical experts.
characters.personality: Norisuke appears to be a nice and somewhat eccentric old man. He displays some pride in his achievements, pointing out his position of first place in the 4th Stage of the race to push Hot Pants to let him use a water well first. He is also quick to talk about his two navels and mentions that they made the newspapers. His participation in the Steel Ball Run shows a great deal of confidence, which is backed up by his ability to stay among the top racers of each step of the race. He notably uses the pronoun 拙者 meaning "this humble one", an archaic and polite first-person pronoun that indicates humbleness. However, he is quite polite despite his tendencies to brag about himself. Norisuke is also

characters.title: Nukesaku
characters.bio: Nukesaku is a tertiary antagonist featured in the third part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, Stardust Crusaders.
characters.background: Nukesaku is one of DIO's many servants within the mansion. He was turned into a vampire at some point by drinking DIO's blood. Nukesaku, disliked by his allies so much, was nicknamed idiot.
characters.personality: Nukesaku is the dim-witted and loyal servant of DIO. He is looked down by the others within DIO's mansion, and ordered to not interfere in the climactic battle. DIO's henchmen seem to detest him so much that he was nicknamed idiot. Although he accepts his nickname, he acts snide when the other henchmen are defeated before him, mocking them for being the useless ones. Since Nukesaku lacks combat strength, he acts as a crying woman to lure his opponents to him. However, he overestimates his bizarre ability and immortality as he is easily defeated by the heroes who coerce him to reveal DIO's location. Despite this, though largely out of fear, Nukesaku displays naive loyalty to DIO.

characters.title: Nunzio Pericolo
characters.name_ja: ヌンツィオ・ペリーコロ
characters.bio: Nunzio Pericolo is a tertiary ally featured in the fifth part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, Vento Aureo.
characters.personality: Pericolo greatly appreciates the boss for giving him a life when nobody else would take him and takes his job very seriously, to the point of committing suicide after passing on a message through Abbacchio's Moody Blues when presented with the order to do so. He is also a friend of Bruno Bucciarati, who greatly appreciates the old man's presence and advice.
characters.ja_kanji: ヌンツィオ・ペリーコロ

characters.title: Ob-La-Di, Ob-La-Da
characters.name_ja: オブラディ・オブラダ
characters.bio: Ob-La-Di, Ob-La-Da is a tertiary antagonist featured in the eighth part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, JoJolion.
characters.background: Ob-La-Di, Ob-La-Da originally lived on a dry, sloped cliff. It was acquired by Toru and the Locacaca Organization at some point.
characters.personality: Ob-La-Di, Ob-La-Da is a parasitic Rock Organism, as it feasts on other organisms' blood and bodily fluids. It is shown to be virtually motionless, only moving whenever attacking or being attacked. It is shown to protect its master, Wonder of U, and it can be inferred that it is subservient to Toru. Ob-La-Di, Ob-La-Da's species target any animal from above or below.
characters.ja_kanji: オブラディ・オブラダ

characters.title: Paco's Father
characters.bio: Paco's Father is an unnamed tertiary character featured in the ninth part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, The JOJOLands. His last name is Laburantes and his first name is unknown.
characters.personality: Paco's father is an aggressive, irresponsible individual with a volatile temper exacerbated by his heavy drinking. He has an instable lifestyle, frequently staying out with various women, neglecting his family responsibilities, leaving a mess around the house, and drinking to the point of vomiting and passing out on the side of the road. He is violent and commits domestic abuse, beating up Paco whenever he is annoyed. Despite his negative traits and abusive nature, he shows brief moments of affection by promising to take Paco out to go fishing with him. He is seemingly a sports fan, as he is shown watching basketball.

characters.title: Page, Jones, Plant, and Bornnam
characters.name_ja: ペイジ・ジョーンズ・プラント・ボーンナム
characters.bio: Page, Jones, Plant, and Bornnam are a group of tertiary antagonists featured in the first part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, Phantom Blood.
characters.background: In the past, the four were knights who were executed in Windknight's Lot. Dio Brando revives them as zombies on December 1, 1888.
characters.personality: Little is known of their personalities, since they are quickly killed by Straizo. However, they are all violent and cruel creatures excited to kill humans.
characters.ja_kanji: ペイジ・ジョーンズ・プラント・ボーンナム
namesakes: Jimmy Page, John Paul Jones, Robert Plant, and John Bonham

characters.title: Palawanicus No.36
characters.bio: Palawanicus No.36, also known as just P-36, is a tertiary ally featured in the eight part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, JoJolion, specifically the "It's a Summer Vacation Everyday" story arc.
characters.background: While traveling in on a business trip for the Higashikata Fruit Parlor, Jobin bought the Palawanicus beetle for ¥110,000 while scouting fruit fields in and the. Jobin notes that the Palawanicus would sell for ¥300,000 in Japan.
characters.personality: Like the rest of Jobin Higashikata's collection, P-36 is an elite athlete, intelligent, aggressive and assertive in mating. Its intelligence spans it a 45-second attention span before it forgets. To draw out its complete potential in its fight with Palawanicus No.28, Josuke uses female pheromones to stimulate it. Palawanicus No.36 also has a great deal of endurance, able to repeatedly lose limbs and keep fighting.

characters.title: Paolo Bucciarati
characters.name_ja: パオロ・ブチャラティ
characters.bio: Paolo Bucciarati is a posthumous tertiary character featured in the fifth part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, Vento Aureo.
characters.personality: Paolo is not a social man, but he is an honest and diligent fisherman. He did all he could to protect his family from the cruelties of the world. Hoping his son would be able to go to a nice school in the city, he zealously fishes and allows other fishermen to ride his boat on his off days to afford the tuition.
characters.ja_kanji: パオロ・ブチャラティ

characters.bio: Parallel World Diego, commonly shortened to The World Diego or simply
characters.background: Parallel World Diego's history prior to his encounter with Valentine is unknown. It can be inferred that, like the original Diego, he chose to participate in the Steel Ball Run race for the prize and prestige. Unlike his base world counterpart, however, Parallel World Diego chooses not to pursue Valentine onto a moving train, a decision that cost the original Diego his life when he was split in two by its wheels.
characters.personality: This incarnation of Diego Brando shares several personality traits with his base world counterpart: like the original Diego, he is misanthropic and ambitious above all, sharing his counterpart's desire for power and dominion over society. However, the methods by which he achieves his goals demonstrate far more overt cruelty and violent tendencies than the original Diego.

characters.title: Perla Pucci
characters.bio: Perla Pucci is a posthumous tertiary character featured in the sixth part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, Stone Ocean.
characters.personality: Perla Pucci is an average, sweet girl living comfortably with her family. She falls in love with Wes Bluemarine, who unbeknownst to both of them, is actually her lost brother Domenico Pucci. While she is strong-willed and slaps the leader of a Ku Klux Klan mob attacking them, she couldn't bear seeing Wes killed, and throws herself off a cliff into a lake.

characters.title: Pink Dark Boy (Character)
characters.bio: Pink Dark Boy, or simply Pink Dark, is the titular protagonist of Rohan Kishibe's horror-suspense manga, Pink Dark Boy.
characters.personality: While the main character's personality is mostly unknown, Koichi Hirose admires the manga's realistic characters and excitement including the titular protagonist Pink Dark Boy.
characters.animedebut:
DU Episode 14
Pink Dark Boy Anime

characters.title: Pinocchio
characters.bio: Pinocchio is a tertiary antagonist featured in the sixth part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, Stone Ocean.
characters.personality:
about who he's a fan of
Pinocchio displays a cheerful and childish demeanor. He is overly concerned with his "fans" and acts as though his primary purpose is to entertain. Egotistically viewing himself as a universally beloved "good guy" and a timeless friend to everyone, he possesses a strong sense of entitlement and false invincibility. He warns Narciso Anasui not to hurt him because "children all around the world would be sad," and even as he is being defeated, he stubbornly insists that the children of the world are his allies.

characters.title: Poco
characters.bio: Poco is a secondary ally featured in the first part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, Phantom Blood.
characters.background: Poco was a cowardly boy who was bullied by other kids, and his sister protected him. When confronted by her about when he was going to fight back and not depend on her anymore, Poco answered that he would do this "tomorrow", which caused her to slap him. When Dio took shelter in Windknight's Lot, he brainwashed Poco to lure Jonathan into a trap.
characters.personality: Poco is introduced as a mischievous and cowardly boy who steals the group's supplies. As their journey goes on, when Jonathan is losing against Tarkus, Poco is shown to be willing to risk his life to help the group despite Speedwagon’s disagreement.

characters.title: Poco's Sister
characters.bio: Poco's Sister is an unnamed tertiary ally featured in the first part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, Phantom Blood.
characters.background: She first appears in Poco's flashback from when he was bullied by the other boys, who run at the sight of her. She then asks Poco when he will stop being a coward and start fighting back. Upon hearing him answer with "tomorrow", she replies with a slap for his cowardly behavior and takes him back home.
characters.personality: Poco's sister is a particularly fierce and righteous girl. She would often stand up to Poco's bullies, frightening them away. At one point, she chides and slaps Poco because of his weakness, encouraging him to become less cowardly. Even in front of the terrifying Vampire Dio Brando, she refuses his temptations for immortality and slaps him.

characters.title: Police
characters.bio: Police is a tertiary character featured in the fourth part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, Diamond is Unbreakable. He is also a primary ally in the light novel Synchronicity in Morioh.
characters.background: Police was born in distant foothills where cool winds blow and raised by breeders named Mr. and Mrs. Nakata. His breeders had eloped following a scandalous double affair, fleeing Tokyo in search of a secluded life together. However, their peaceful escape was short-lived, as rumors about them spread in their community. In response, the couple bought a large piece of land and started raising dogs. As a puppy, Police was unaware of their circumstances and only perceived their home as quiet and sparsely visited.
characters.personality: Police is called a senile dog by Koichi. He has a sluggish demeanor, known for spending most of his day napping outside the Hirose residence. Since he is always sleeping, Koichi even checks if he is alive.

characters.title: President's Aides
characters.bio: The unnamed President's Aides are two tertiary antagonists featured in the seventh part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, Steel Ball Run.
characters.personality: The President's two aides serve as loyal subordinates to Funny Valentine, acting as his direct enforcers, liaisons, and guards. Both aides are willing to carry out morally questionable orders without hesitation, whether it involves orchestrating Gyro Zeppeli and Johnny Joestar's assassinations or drugging Lucy Steel to keep her asleep while she is pregnant. Although the two are not stated to be Stand users, they are both aware of Stands, as Valentine tells them to summon Stand users.

characters.title: Prince
characters.bio: Prince, born Prince Rogers Nelson, was an American singer, songwriter, multi-instrumentalist, producer, and actor. His music combined funk, R&B, rock, and pop, and he was known for his elaborate performances, distinctive fashion, and independence as a recording artist.
aliases: The Artist Formerly Known as Prince

characters.title: Put Back
characters.bio: The tentatively-named Put Back, referred to simply as the "Hero", is a tertiary ally featured in the sixth part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, Stone Ocean.
characters.personality: Despite his seemingly human appearance, Put Back displays no personality or dialogue. His goal is to send back the fictional characters summoned by Bohemian Rhapsody to their works of fiction and return the world to normality.

characters.title: Radio Gaga
characters.bio: Radio Gaga is a secondary antagonist featured in the eighth part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, JoJolion, specifically the "" story arc.
characters.background: Radio Gaga's origin is unknown prior to it taking residence in a guard rail near the Twin Pines, but is suspected by Lucy Steel to be a "guard dog" for the Locacaca fruit being grown in the nearby orchard. At some point, the creature was responsible for the disappearance of a woman, having lured and devoured her, though it's implied that it claimed more human lives. The disappearance of the woman was dubbed the "Radio Gaga Incident", making the spot it inhabited famous.
characters.personality: Radio Gaga is malevolent, as it disguises itself as a guard rail and lures in victims such as birds and other animals. It's also shown reprimanding Lucy and Joseph for abandoning their seemingly dead driver, calling them low-lives and their actions inhumane. Lucy compares the creature to be similar to a snake or guard dog. The creature is shown to have a cowardly side, as it decides to flee after being beaten up by Joseph Joestar and his Stand.

characters.title: Reimi Sugimoto
characters.bio: Reimi Sugimoto is a primary ally featured in the fourth part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, Diamond is Unbreakable, introduced in the "Rohan Kishibe's Adventure" story arc.
characters.background: Reimi Sugimoto was born around 1967 and raised in Morioh. According to Heaven's Door, she lived in Kotodai neighborhood, Block 3, Section 12. She had her first at 11 years and 9 months of age, and her first kiss was a.
characters.personality: Reimi is composed, genial, and caring. She is firm in a voluntary responsibility to bring Kira to justice. Reimi is normally alone in her alley with her dog Arnold.
characters.residence:
Ghost Girl's Alley, Morioh, Japan
Kotodai, Morioh, Japan

characters.title: Rina Higashikata
characters.bio: Rina Higashikata is a tertiary character briefly featured in the seventh part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, Steel Ball Run, and in the eighth part, JoJolion.
characters.personality: Rina is described as a loving and faithful wife, as seen when she placed her utmost trust in her husband, Johnny, as she was suffering from the Rock Disease. She also remained unmarried after his death. Her maternal love is evident when she continued to care for her son, George III, as a single mother after Johnny's sacrifice to cure him of the same disease, and even years after with her grandson,.

characters.title: Robert E. O. Speedwagon
characters.name_ja: ロバート・E・O・スピードワゴン
characters.bio: Robert E. O. Speedwagon is a primary ally featured in the first part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, Phantom Blood. Formerly a Londoner thug residing in Ogre Street, Speedwagon befriends Jonathan Joestar and becomes a loyal ally to his cause.
characters.background: Robert E. O. Speedwagon was born on October 16, 1863. Speedwagon lived most of his life in darkness. He grew up on Ogre Street and spent his childhood stealing and fighting to get by. It reached the point of him being able to tell a good person apart from a bad person just by their smell. He eventually became the leader of the thieves in Ogre Street and befriended Amato and Tattoo.
characters.personality: Robert E. O. Speedwagon is a hot-blooded but honorable street thug and later businessman.
characters.ja_kanji: ロバート・E・O・スピードワゴン
occupations: Oil industry magnate & Speedwagon Foundation CEO

characters.title: Rock Human
characters.bio: The Rock Humans are a subspecies of Rock Organisms, serving as the primary antagonistic force in the eighth part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, JoJolion.

characters.title: Rock Organism
characters.bio: Rock Organisms are a silicon-based species of life, featured in the eighth part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, JoJolion.

characters.title: Rods
characters.bio: Rods, also known as Skyfish, are a group of tertiary antagonists featured in the sixth part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, Stone Ocean, specifically the "Sky High" story arc.
characters.background: The rods have descended from a genus called that first emerged 3 to 4 hundred million years ago and is closely related to the. During the and periods, the rods targeted dinosaurs from the sea and expanded their habitat into the air.
characters.personality: The rods are parasitic, as they feast on other organisms' body heat. They live in remote locations and travel in swarms. Under the influence of Sky High, they act on Rikiel's will, though these mechanisms are theorized to be more of a trust relationship. Whenever Rikiel loses his confidence, the rods either suspend in midair or turn against him. After Rikiel's defeat, the rods simply leave their master.

characters.title: Rohan Kishibe (The JOJOLands)
characters.bio: Rohan Kishibe is a secondary ally featured in the ninth part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, The JOJOLands.
characters.background: Rohan is a manga artist from Morioh. He has a pet dog, though he left him in Japan when he traveled to Hawaii on a plane from Narita International Airport.
characters.personality: Rohan Kishibe is an inquisitive and passionate manga artist dedicated to his work. To gain inspiration, Rohan is constantly seeking new experiences or facts, investigating anything regardless of the danger or legality. For instance, he explores a volcanic area, takes detailed photos, and brings back samples of cooled lava with him despite the area being forbidden to tourists. He is easily able to discern when something appears suspicious, such as when he wonders about the cat at his house, as well as how the rain only targeted a specific spot.

characters.title: Romeo Jisso
characters.bio: Romeo Jisso is a tertiary antagonist and, later on, tertiary ally featured in the sixth part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, Stone Ocean.
characters.background: In 2008, Romeo met and began dating Jolyne Cujoh. At some point before the events of Stone Ocean, he was accepted into an unnamed university.
characters.personality: Romeo bears the stereotypes of a son born into wealth: cowardly, selfish, and unwilling to admit to his responsibilities. He initially comes across as kind and flirtatious towards his ex-girlfriend, Jolyne Cujoh, but this attitude changes drastically after he seemingly crashes his car into a hitchhiker. Instead of calling the authorities he begs Jolyne to help him hide the body instead, putting emphasis on the dangers it could present to their future if the body is found. When that plan foils, he places the blame of his car accident on Jolyne out of worry for his college admissions. He is also shown to have paid off a lawyer (who, interestingly, also acted under Johngalli A.'s orders) to pla

characters.title: Roses
characters.bio: Roses is a tertiary ally featured in the third part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, Stardust Crusaders.
characters.background: Roses is hired as a butler for the Joestar Family around 1958, since Holy was a child. When Holy becomes sick and Joseph Joestar travels to Egypt, Roses is left to take care of Suzi Q.
characters.personality: Roses is the driver and longtime butler of the Joestar Family. Due to his time as a butler, he grows close to the family and feels sentimental over them. He greatly worries when Holy Kujo becomes sick and struggles to tell Suzi Q Joestar how severe her daughter's situation is. Roses is familiar with Japan's customs and warns Suzi Q not to get into trouble, even scolding her when she almost gets attacked by a yakuza member. However, he puts up with her nonchalance and is capable of protecting her when a situation arises.
characters.residence:
New York City, New York, USA
Kujo Mansion, Tokyo, Japan

characters.title: Ru Hayama
characters.bio: Ru Hayama is a secondary character featured in the spin-off manga Toshikazu Hazamada's Questionable Adventure. She is also mentioned in Diamond is Unbreakable, the fourth part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series.
characters.personality: The star that everyone sees in public is a kind-hearted elegant girl with a sweet act toward anyone she sees, including strangers and creepy fans. Ru maintains a professional, polite attitude throughout her events, reciting ridiculous usernames like "Fishbreeder" with a straight face and even handling Hazamada's bizarrely foolish behavior with grace. Due to her life as an idol, she's diligently careful at never letting any of her private thoughts slip in public, which includes the fact that she has a boyfriend. Despite never knowing her in person, Toshikazu Hazamada calls her an angel.

characters.title: Rudol von Stroheim
characters.name_ja: ルドル・フォン・シュトロハイム
characters.bio: Rudol von Stroheim is a primary ally featured in the second part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, Battle Tendency.
characters.personality: Rudol von Stroheim is a cruel and callous of the. His introduction paints him as a comically sadistic man. He orders a woman to lick his wound clean only for him to threaten to cut her tongue shortly after with the shaving razor, executes Mexican civilians for a blood extraction experiment, and uses a serum to forcibly extract information from Speedwagon. He is also quite overconfident and a bit too arrogant in his own schemes to account for failure.
characters.ja_kanji: ルドル・フォン・シュトロハイム

characters.title: Ryohei Higashikata
characters.bio: Ryohei Higashikata is a tertiary character featured in the fourth part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, Diamond is Unbreakable. He also appears as a tertiary ally in the spin off manga Crazy Diamond's Demonic Heartbreak.
characters.background:
and grandson during the summer
Ryohei was born around 1944. He had a daughter with an unnamed woman in 1962, who they named Tomoko Higashikata. Two years later, he joined the police force, serving as a police officer in Morioh for 35 years. In around 1976, he managed to arrest Anjuro Katagiri, a 12-year-old boy who committed robbery and rape.
characters.personality: Ryohei is a humorous and carefree man. He enjoys playing jokes on his family, such as when he points a toy gun at Josuke. Additionally, he can be lenient when enforcing the law, especially with his family, as he lightheartedly ignored a man's plea to have Tomoko arrested after being assaulted by her. However, Ryohei is overall a respectable police officer who takes his job seriously. He is dedicated to keeping Morioh safe and takes on a more serious attitude when he learns of any crimes. Despite his age, he is willing to work night shifts. He also has never been promoted in the 35 years of his work, but he remains as dedicated as he always has been in protecting Morioh.

characters.title: Sadao Kujo
characters.bio: Sadao Kujo is a tertiary character featured in the third part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, Stardust Crusaders.
characters.background: Sadao married Holy Kujo, the only daughter of Joseph Joestar. After Holy moved to Japan, Sadao purchased a mansion for him and his family to live in. They had their son, Jotaro Kujo.

characters.title: Santana
characters.bio: Santana is a secondary antagonist featured in the second part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, Battle Tendency. His real name is unknown, since Rudol von Stroheim names him based on the.
characters.background: Santana was originally born somewhere within the American continent. After Kars's rampage and slaughter of their clan, the infants Santana and Wamuu were taken away, adopted and trained by Kars and Esidisi. Santana was later left behind in Mexico by Kars, who deemed him only useful as a guard dog, while he and the others left for the old world to find a flawless Red Stone of Aja. As a result, Santana would be unaware of the energy called Ripple which the other Pillar Men learned and developed defenses against. Eventually, claiming that it was because he used too much power, Santana entered a 2000-year-long rest by fusing himself into a pillar underneath a pyramid that was one of the proponen
characters.personality: Santana is a calm, observant, and highly intelligent Pillar Man. He is adaptable and inquisitive about how the world has changed while he was asleep. Although Stroheim initially assumes that Santana is a primitive creature due to him slipping on water and then scratching his body and hair for a while, Santana proves that his knowledge is far beyond what humans are capable of. He quickly learns to become fluent in another language shortly after hearing the Nazis speak, easily discovers how to escape from the shelter he was locked inside by contorting his body to escape through a vent, and is capable of disassembling a gun in seconds which would normally take humans hours of training to learn.
characters.residence:
Cave Ruins, Mexico 
Pillar Men Settlement

characters.title: Satoru Nakae
characters.bio: Satoru Nakae is a tertiary character featured in the fourth part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, Diamond is Unbreakable. During the investigation, Hayato Kawajiri witnessed him and his girlfriend Minako Okura being killed by Yoshikage Kira.
characters.personality: Satoru, much like his girlfriend, is seemingly quite rude and quick to make bold assumptions about others. He and his girlfriend, Minako Okura, are quick to assume Kira is a thief despite the latter merely pushing Minako's bag off his lap. They are also willing to quickly shift blame onto Kira for them bumping into him despite their carelessness being the cause. Despite their attitude, they're both intimate with each-other as a happy couple.
occupations: Third-year student at S City M Community College

characters.title: Savage Garden
characters.bio: Savage Garden is a tertiary ally featured in the sixth part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, Stone Ocean.
characters.personality: Being a pigeon, it doesn't display any noticeable personality. It simply follows orders and successfully retrieves Star Platinum's DISC from Green Dolphin Street Prison.

characters.title: Scarlet Valentine
characters.name_ja: スカーレット・ヴァレンタイン
characters.bio: Scarlet Valentine is a secondary antagonist featured in the seventh part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, Steel Ball Run, specifically in the "Tubular Bells" story arc.
characters.background: Fifteen years before the Steel Ball Run, Scarlet met Funny Valentine at a house party in her hometown while she was a student. The two danced together, which was when she discovered he could walk without making footsteps and play Mozart on mandolin with his feet. Coupled with this, she fell in love with his sharp, but warm-hearted personality. The two eventually married, and following Valentine's presidential inauguration, she became the First Lady of the United States.
characters.personality: Scarlet is a strong and ambitious woman. She is not shy, having no trouble talking about her husband even when she is seducing a woman, and often takes the initiative. Scarlet follows her impulses when in a relationship. She is bisexual, as she shows affection towards her husband, but also desires intimate contact with women. One of her fetishes seems to be facesitting. She also prefers to be berated during sex according to her husband.
characters.ja_kanji: スカーレット・ヴァレンタイン
occupations: First Lady of the United States

characters.title: She Who Dances with the Leaves
characters.name_en: She Who Dances with the Leaves
characters.bio: She Who Dances with the Leaves in her tribe's native language, often referred to simply as Sandman's Sister, is a tertiary character featured in the seventh part of JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, Steel Ball Run.
characters.background: As a Native American, Sandman's sister lived with her younger brother in the Arizona Desert. Although Sandman's sister is never given a name, in her people's language, she is known as "She Who Dances with the Leaves".
characters.personality: Sandman's sister is a traditionalist who strongly adheres to her peoples' values and beliefs. She disapproves of Sandman's interest in the white man's books and culture, seeing it as a betrayal of their community. She is strict and protective of her younger brother, scolding him and severely beating him for going against their customs.

characters.title: Sheriff Derek
characters.bio: Sheriff Derek is a tertiary character featured in the seventh part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, Steel Ball Run, and a secondary ally in the light novel Lonesome Tim.
characters.personality: Derek is a highly professional, observant, and fair lawman who adheres strictly to the laws and unwritten codes of the American West. Despite the brutal nature of his job, he maintains a level head. When Gyro Zeppeli uses the Spin to make a pickpocket shoot himself, Derek calmly assesses the situation and lets Gyro go, declaring that since both parties agreed to a fair duel, no laws were actually broken. He is also highly pragmatic and protective of the public peace; when discovering a gruesome mass murder during the race, he deliberately keeps newspapermen away from the crime scene to prevent a mass panic.

characters.title: Shigekiyo Yangu
characters.bio: Shigekiyo Yangu, nicknamed Shigechi, is a secondary ally featured in the fourth part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, Diamond is Unbreakable, specifically in the "'Shigechi's' Harvest" and "Yoshikage Kira Just Wants to Live Quietly" story arcs.
characters.background: Shigekiyo Yangu was born around 1985-1986 and seemingly lived a normal childhood. His parents gave him the nickname Shigechi and he got a pet turtle named Gonta at some point.
characters.personality: Shigechi initially comes off as naive or unintelligent, with little thought for the creative use of his powers beyond gathering lost change. He notably mentioned licking stamps to see if the glue tastes different depending on the stamp, and he keeps a chewing-gum on the back of his mother's photograph to chew on later.

characters.title: Shinobu Kawajiri
characters.bio: Shinobu Kawajiri is a secondary character featured in the fourth part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, Diamond is Unbreakable.
characters.background: Shinobu first met Kosaku Kawajiri in community college and dated him because her friends thought he was cool. They married when she became pregnant. After years in a passionless marriage, she has grown to resent her husband and would have divorced him long ago if not for their son Hayato.
characters.personality: Shinobu has a personality closer to that of a younger woman than a responsible mother, detesting her marriage. While she felt no hatred towards Kosaku, her relationship with him was cold and full of regret. She wished for more excitement in her life and often lashed out at her husband and son out of frustration. Though she resents her son for trapping her in her marriage, she occasionally reaches out to him, only to be ignored. She is very pleased when he finally begins to return her affection.

characters.title: Silver Bullet
characters.bio: Silver Bullet is a secondary character featured in the seventh part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, Steel Ball Run. It is a horse belonging to Diego Brando, who rides it for the entirety of the Steel Ball Run race.
characters.personality: Little is known about Silver Bullet's personality, but it is loyal to Diego Brando and serves as his mount throughout the entirety of the Steel Ball Run. Diego considers it his beloved horse.

characters.title: Slow Dancer
characters.bio: Slow Dancer is a primary ally featured in the seventh part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, Steel Ball Run. It is a horse belonging to Johnny Joestar, who rides it for the entirety of the Steel Ball Run race.
characters.background: Slow Dancer was a farm horse that was sold to Johnny by a horse seller before the Steel Ball Run race begun. Despite being paralyzed from the waist down and struggling to control the horse, Johnny is determined to ride it.
characters.personality: Slow Dancer was described as an untamable horse with a twisted personality that cannot be easily handled. When Johnny first attempts to saddle it, Slow Dancer reacts with unpredictability and almost tramples him to death. However, when Johnny shows humility asking for its aid by the start of the race, Slow Dancer warms up to Johnny and shows affection by gently licking his face when he's injured. This allows Johnny to finally mount it once he realizes how to use the Spin.

characters.title: Smokey Brown
characters.name_ja: スモーキー・ブラウン
characters.bio: Smokey Brown is a tertiary ally featured in the second part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, Battle Tendency.
characters.personality: Smokey is friendly and mild-mannered. He is often shocked by the fantastic, horrific situations that surround his friend Joseph Joestar. Smokey operated as a thief and looked down on Joseph at first since he was easy picking, and he was also fearful of the New York's police. Smokey was also driven enough to work towards becoming mayor of his native town in Georgia.
characters.ja_kanji: スモーキー・ブラウン

characters.title: Sonny Likir
characters.bio: Sonny Likir is a tertiary character featured in the sixth part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, Stone Ocean. He is one of the prison guards stationed in the Ultra Security House Unit of Green Dolphin Street Prison during Jolyne's time there.
characters.personality: Ordinarily, Sonny appears to be a rather aloof guard who enjoys antagonizing convicts. He distracts himself during his guard shift by doing bets with his fellow guard, Viviano Westwood.

characters.title: Sorbet and Gelato
characters.name_ja: ソルベ・と・ジェラート
characters.bio: Sorbet and Gelato are two posthumous tertiary characters featured in the fifth part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, Vento Aureo. They are also the protagonists of the short story "Prima che il Gelato si Sciolga".
characters.background: Before joining Passione, Sorbet was a soldier in the Italian army. He was discharged after assaulting a superior officer, whom he had beaten half to death due to the officer bullying his subordinates. Sorbet explained this was not out of a sense of justice, but because he could not stand arrogant individuals who looked down on their subordinates, finding it exhilarating to see the terror on his face when confronted. At some point, he got a black compact car which is the same type of car that a famous phantom thief in Japan has. He kept the car in good shape for ten years.
characters.personality: Little is known about Sorbet and Gelato's personalities in the manga, as they died prior to the events of Vento Aureo. However, they are described as heinous criminals and were always very close, leading to rumors about the true nature of their relationship. They are rebellious as they decide to defy the rules of Passione. Sorbet and Gelato risking their lives to investigate the Boss's identity by themselves could indicate either overconfidence or bravery.
characters.ja_kanji: ソルベ・と・ジェラート

characters.title: Steven Steel
characters.name_ja: スティーブン・スティール
characters.bio: Steven Steel is a secondary ally featured in the seventh part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, Steel Ball Run.
characters.background:
Steven Steel was born in 1840 in New York to a family of Irish immigrants. His father was a blacksmith and Steven was the fourth of a family of seven children. When he was 15 he fell in love with the beautiful daughter of a florist and the two vowed to be together, but she died in a carriage accident that year. At the time, Steven fell into a deep state of despair and promised to never fall in love again. He joined the cavalry but was never sent to wars nor expeditions. He spent two years in a deserted island hospital. In the following years, he changed jobs each year until he was 28. These jobs are:
- 1856-1863: Circus performer. He began with a simple trick and swallowed fish before making
characters.personality: Steven Steel is shown to be an anxious character despite bearing a bold facade as the organizer and host of the Steel Ball Run race. During most of his life, Steven Steel has cultivated a bombastic and eccentric persona, becoming a performer, sportsman and other jobs in the center of the stage, but would find his calling as a promoter for various events. Despite the ups and downs of his career, Steven has managed to always rebound to success. Steven also projects the image of a stern and confident promoter who tackles any problem with calm and authority. When a clerk reports numerous problems during the preparations, Steven calmly raises the budget and orders to make it clear troublemakers w
characters.ja_kanji: スティーブン・スティール

characters.title: Steven Steel's Secretary
characters.name_ja: スティーブン・スティールの秘書
characters.bio: Steven Steel's Secretary is an unnamed tertiary character featured in the seventh part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, Steel Ball Run.
characters.personality:
about the true goals of the Steel Ball Run
The secretary shows himself to be professional from the surface, though somewhat underhanded in his methods. As the manager of the Steel Ball Run, he listens to complaints filed before reciting them to Steven Steel. He serves as Steven's voice of reason in the beginning of the race, informing him of budget problems, and accidents. Despite this, he easily backs down and listens to Steven's orders. Acting from the shadows, he advises Steel to confront Gyro Zeppeli directly over his nationality after discovering Gyro's ties to European nobility.
characters.ja_kanji: スティーブン・スティールの秘書

characters.title: Straizo
characters.bio: Straizo is a secondary ally featured in the first part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, Phantom Blood, and a secondary antagonist in the second part, Battle Tendency.
characters.personality: When Straizo appears alongside Tonpetty and Dire, he appears to be a noble Ripple user who wants to put an end to Dio's ambitions of world domination in order to protect humanity. His benevolence is displayed when he aids Jonathan in defeating zombies, and particularly when he rescues Poco and his sister. He also has a habit of uttering the phrase "I, Straizo, will show no mercy". Straizo becomes an acquaintance of Speedwagon during the 50 years leading up to Battle Tendency, with the latter trusting him to destroy Santana before he had reawakened.

characters.title: Suzi Q
characters.bio: She is Lisa Lisa's servant, but she herself lacks any ability to fight. Joseph Joestar saves her from Esidisi's attack, and she and Joseph later marry. She is the mother of Holy Kujo and the grandmother of Jotaro Kujo.
characters.personality:
again
Suzi Q is initially introduced as Lisa Lisa's ditzy, yet humble servant working on the Air Supplena Island. She was a carefree young woman, who became fond of Joseph Joestar and tearfully hoped to see him return after defeating the Pillar Men. Though she is trusted by Lisa Lisa, Suzi Q is quite silly; she has difficulty deciding between two things, she isn't able to recognize Joseph without his mask, finds his mouth weird looking, and after surviving his battle with Kars, Suzi Q forgot to send a telegram meant to inform Joseph's friends and family about his survival and their marriage.
characters.residence:
New York City, New York, USA
Air Supplena Island, Venice, Italy 
Kujo Mansion, Tokyo, Japan

characters.title: Suzuyo Hirose
characters.bio: Suzuyo Hirose is a tertiary character featured in the eighth part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, JoJolion.
characters.background:
's suicide attempt 
Suzuyo Hirose married an unnamed man, and later had their only daughter, Yasuho Hirose. However, when Yasuho was 10 years old, Suzuyo and her husband divorced.
characters.personality: Suzuyo is an irresponsible and carefree woman. Though she wishes to mend things with Yasuho, their relationship is often strained because of her. She enjoys a profligate lifestyle doing things such as playing video games and drinking alcohol often. On one occasion, Yasuho discovers Suzuyo drunk and asleep on the floor of her house with a hickey on her chest. Moreover, it is shown that she once left Yasuho at a summer camp in order to have a vacation in.

characters.title: Tama
characters.bio: Tama is a secondary character featured in the fourth part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, Diamond is Unbreakable, introduced in the "Cats Love Yoshikage Kira" story arc.
characters.personality: Tama is a typical cat who is stubborn and territorial to his spot in the cellar when Shinobu Kawajiri attempts to chase him out. When his Stand ability manifests, he resurrects as a plant with the memories of his previous life and because of this he has similar characteristics of any normal cat. Like all cats, Stray Cat has a hunter instinct and is seen chasing after insects, thrown pieces of paper, and birds. He is proud of his former fur and tail. He loves running and jumping but cannot do so as a plant. Stray Cat likes tuna, shrimp, sticking his head in paper sacks, watching TV, and being praised. Like all cats, he dislikes direct eye contact, having his nose blocked, cigarette smoke, was
characters.residence:
Nijimura Residence, Jozenji 4-1280, Morioh, Japan
Kawajiri Residence, Morioh, Japan

characters.title: Taoka
characters.bio: Taoka is a tertiary character featured in the eighth part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, JoJolion.
characters.personality: Taoka is an ordinary journalist, lacking in notable traits. He is analytical, as when he receives a package containing evidence against the hospital director's research, he quickly understands the situation behind the development of the Locacaca. When he meets the hospital director for an interview, he introduces himself politely. As the interview goes on, he slowly turns confrontational towards the director, and threatens to expose him for his unethical research.

characters.title: Tarkus
characters.bio: Tarkus is a primary antagonist featured in the first part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, Phantom Blood.
characters.background: Born in the 16th century, Tarkus was a member of the and a retainer of Mary Stuart. After losing his relatives in previous wars, the young Tarkus was brought up as Mary Stuart's knight and trained his body for that sole purpose, eventually becoming attached to Mary. Alongside his fellow retainer Bruford, Tarkus passed the trial of the 77 Rings in 1563, becoming one of the only five in history to complete it. He also trained in Windknight's Lot, competing in the Chain Neck Deathmatch at the Chamber of the Two-Headed Dragon in which he became a specialist. He boasts of killing 48 opponents in such deathmatches.
characters.personality: Tarkus was a powerful knight during the time he was alive, and loyal to his queen. However, unlike his partner Bruford, he lacks a sense of honor. Tarkus gets enraged easily and uses his anger for violence. Due to the corruption of Dio, he thinks of Bruford as a disgrace to the 77 Rings winners, having no qualms about destroying the armor of his former friend. Tarkus is a brutal and ruthless fighter and enjoys forcing his opponents to battle him to the death in the Chain Neck Deathmatch, even if it is against their own will.

characters.title: Tattoo
characters.bio: Tattoo, as referred to by Speedwagon, is a tertiary ally featured in the first part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, Phantom Blood. As a resident of Ogre Street, he initially tries to rob Jonathan Joestar alongside Speedwagon and Amato.
characters.personality: Not much is known about Tattoo's personality, but he is a rowdy, violent street thug. As a thief from the dangerous alley known as Ogre Street, Tattoo is known to attack strangers alongside his two friends. He is known for using a knife, and shows no remorse for maiming and dismembering his opponents.

characters.title: Tomoko Higashikata
characters.bio: Tomoko Higashikata is a secondary character featured in the fourth part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, Diamond is Unbreakable.
characters.background: Sometime before 1983, Tomoko had an affair with Joseph Joestar while still in university. The 62-year-old man was married to Suzi Q at the time, and so Tomoko didn't tell him that she was pregnant with his illegitimate child, whom she named Josuke. Joseph only learned of Josuke when the boy was 16.
characters.personality: A single mother and teacher, Tomoko is known to show a strong temperament, disliking it when guys try to hit on her (as she still loves Joseph) and she gets annoyed quite easily. She also seems to be mildly perceptive, noticing that the seal on her milk that Angelo had given her was broken. Despite her sharp temperament, she is mostly a kind person, particularly to her family and friends.

characters.title: Tomoko Higashikata (JoJolion)
characters.bio: Tomoko Higashikata is a posthumous tertiary character featured in the eighth part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, JoJolion.
characters.personality: Tomoko is a calm and devoted mother who prioritizes her family's well-being. She is composed in moments of crisis and provides reassurance to Norisuke before his illness, ultimately calmly choosing to cure him through an Equivalent Exchange, sacrificing her life.

characters.title: Tonpetty
characters.bio: Tonpetty is a secondary ally featured in the first part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, Phantom Blood. He is a Ripple master who trained Will Anthonio Zeppeli, later joining forces with Jonathan directly alongside his disciples Straizo and Dire.
characters.background: Tonpetty is a Tibetan Ripple master who trained Dire and the then 25-year-old Zeppeli in the ways of the Ripple. He eventually revealed to Zeppeli that he would face a gruesome death if his training continued. Nevertheless, Zeppeli decided to continue with his training and pursue the Stone Mask. Upon discovering its location, Zeppeli wrote a letter to Tonpetty to ask for help in destroying it.
characters.personality: Tonpetty is a wise, world-worn man who shows great concern for others; during Zeppeli's training, Tonpetty warned him about his fate but did not attempt to dissuade him forcefully.

characters.title: Tory Alohaoe
characters.bio: Tory Alohaoe is a tertiary character featured in the ninth part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, The JOJOLands.
characters.background: Tory lives with her mother and older brother in an apartment in Oahu. The family had paid $15,000 in medical expenses related to Tory's muscular disorder condition within a year.
characters.personality: Tory's personality is mostly unknown. She calls her mother "mama" and reacts with concern from her mother's distress. When the alarm from a virus on her mother's laptop stops and her mother is relieved, Tory also smiles with relief.

characters.title: Urmd Avdul
characters.name_ja: ウルムド・アブドゥル
characters.bio: Urmd Avdul is a tertiary antagonist featured in the seventh part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, Steel Ball Run.
characters.background: Urmd Avdul is a racer who hails from. It is mentioned that he crosses the Sahara Desert three times annually.
characters.personality: Little is known about Urmd Avdul's personality, as he is swiftly defeated by Gyro Zeppeli. However, he is a competitive racer, being a champion candidate of the Steel Ball Run race. He appears ambitious to some degree, as he is said to cross the three times annually.
characters.ja_kanji: ウルムド・アブドゥル

characters.title: Valkyrie
characters.bio: Valkyrie is a primary ally featured in the seventh part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, Steel Ball Run. It is a horse belonging to Gyro Zeppeli, who rides it for the entirety of the Steel Ball Run race.
characters.background: Valkyrie is a born in Europe around 1886, making it four years old at the time of the Steel Ball Run. It is implied that Valkyrie has been with Gyro for a considerable amount of time, allowing the two to develop a close bond. Valkyrie travels with Gyro from the Kingdom of Naples to America before the start of the race.
characters.personality: Little is known about Valkyrie's personality, but it faithfully serves as Gyro Zeppeli's mount throughout the entirety of the Steel Ball Run. Diego Brando observes that Valkyrie has a quirk of suddenly swaying to its left every eight breaths it takes. Gyro himself was unaware about Valkyrie's habit, but uses it to his advantage by exploiting it with his Steel Balls and the Spin.

characters.title: Van Gogh's Self-Portrait
characters.bio: Van Gogh's Self-Portrait, or simply Van Gogh, is a tertiary antagonist featured in the sixth part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, Stone Ocean.
characters.personality: The self-portrait of Van Gogh is mostly calm throughout his interactions with Weather Report. He is shown to be quite knowledgeable of the life experiences, hardships, and general info about the real Vincent van Gogh. As Weather begins to experience the story of the famous painter, including his death, the portrait is seemingly uncaring of Weather's fated demise. When Weather warns not to touch the pistol, Van Gogh is frightened by the prospect of even going near the weapon to avoid meeting the same fate befalling Weather. As Weather begins to experience the end of Vincent van Gogh's story, the portrait starts to gloat about taking over Weather's place. His cowardly side is revealed when Wea

characters.title: Versus's Mother
characters.bio: Versus's Mother is an unnamed tertiary character featured in the sixth part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, Stone Ocean. She is the mother of Donatello Versus.
characters.background: Versus's mother, alongside Giorno's Mother, was one of the many lovers DIO was involved with during his stay in Cairo before the events of Stardust Crusaders. However, DIO saw his lovers as merely tools or meals. According to herself, Versus's mother used to be a "big shot."
characters.personality: Versus's mother had a poor relationship with her son. Both she and her husband would often ramble to him about their past glories as "big shots." Versus's mother also never told him about his father, who he only learned through Enrico Pucci. Versus's mother had little interest in her son, as both she and her husband favored Versus's stepsisters instead.

characters.title: Wamuu
characters.bio: Wamuu is a primary antagonist featured in the second part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, Battle Tendency.
characters.background: Wamuu is a member of the same race as Kars. After Kars and Esidisi exterminated their clan, Wamuu and Santana were taken in by the two of them since they were infants. After being trained by the two, Wamuu became a strong warrior with honed instincts. Wamuu accompanied his masters to find a flawless Red Stone of Aja. During their travels, he participated in the extermination of the Ripple Clan. However, he was reluctant to kill a child from the clan, so Kars killed the boy himself.
characters.personality: Wamuu's most notable traits are his love of battle and his sense of honor, such that he stops himself from finishing off a defenseless Joseph Joestar on the mere possibility that he can wash away an earlier humiliation inflicted by Joseph when he'll beat him as soon as he becomes a fine and powerful Ripple warrior.
characters.residence:
Colosseum Cavern, Rome, Italy 
Pillar Men Settlement

characters.title: Wang Chan
characters.bio: Wang Chan is a primary antagonist featured in the first part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, Phantom Blood.
characters.background: Wang Chan was a shop owner operating in Ogre Street, the most dangerous part of London. When a young Dio Brando came to buy slow-acting poison from him to kill his father Dario Brando, he was unconcerned by Dio's evilness and told him of a man in his own land who had a similar birthmark to Dio's. The man in question had a harsh life, but lived to be over 183 years old.
characters.personality: As a human, Wang Chan shows a nasty and greedy personality, selling poison to Dio for fun without any regard for its use. He also doesn't mind violence, smiling when Dio stabs George Joestar. Later, he heads back to the Joestar Mansion after it burns to the ground to salvage the Stone Mask in order to sell it for a profit.

characters.title: Wekapipo
characters.bio: Wekapipo is a secondary antagonist, later a secondary ally, featured in the seventh part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, Steel Ball Run. Introduced as an antagonist in the "Wrecking Ball" story arc, he then becomes an ally to Johnny Joestar and Gyro Zeppeli.
characters.background: Wekapipo hails from the Kingdom of Naples; his only family was his dear little sister. Wekapipo became one of the royal guards and learned to use the Spin with his Wrecking Balls. He rose to become one of the elite guards, working directly for the royal family. When his sister was 17 (and he was 24), Wekapipo arranged for her to marry the son of a wealthy financial commissioner, assuring her wealth. Incidentally, the husband was a friend of his in the guard. However, six months later, Wekapipo visited his sister. He found her sobbing in a corner, her face swollen because of her husband's beating. Furious, Wekapipo wanted to seek the husband and his sister begged him to stop as this was a mat
characters.personality: Wekapipo is a remarkably stern and serious individual, focusing on whatever goal he has and tolerating little the hijinks of Magent Magent.

characters.title: Wekapipo's Brother-in-Law
characters.bio: Wekapipo's brother-in-law is an unnamed tertiary antagonist featured in the seventh part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, Steel Ball Run.
characters.background: Born into a noble family from the Kingdom of Naples as the son of a wealthy financial commissioner, Wekapipo's brother-in-law had his position, wealth and status secured from birth. He would eventually became one of the royal guards and learned to use the Spin with his Wrecking Balls. While his position in the royal guards is unknown, he is known to have been a friend of Wekapipo beforehand from a similar line of work. When Wekapipo's sister turned 17, a marriage between her and the nobleman was arranged as Wekapipo believed his ensured wealth and status would likely bring her comfort and safety.
characters.personality: Wekapipo's brother-in-law is shown to be highly abusive, aggressive and cruel towards his wife. Due to his noble status, he takes advantage of his status and takes any dishonor or shame to his family's name personally while maintaining an appearance of nobility by upholding tradition. He chastises Wekapipo's requests that the nobleman divorce his sister for her safety as a divorce, with the church's approval, caused by physical abuse would bring great shame to his family's name. He regards Wekapipo's sister as a "boring lay", regularly using physical violence against her to the point she eventually became blind.

characters.title: Wekapipo's Sister
characters.bio: Wekapipo's sister is an unnamed tertiary character featured in the seventh part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, Steel Ball Run.
characters.background:
During her childhood, the girl had lived a secluded life in her hometown, only having heard of the ocean. At some point during her teenage years, her older brother, the royal guardsman Wekapipo, pushed for her to marry into the family of a friend and colleague of his from the royal guard, due to his family's wealth and status. When she turned seventeen, she saw the ocean for the first time on her wedding day.

This marriage would quickly prove to have been a failure, as her husband would regularly beat her, which she would blame herself for. Six months after the wedding, Wekapipo visited her residence and discovered her sobbing profusely, her face bloody and bruised. After unknowingly knoc
characters.personality:
's abuse
The woman displays a level of anxiousness and denial that leaves her vulnerable to her husband's physical and psychological abuse. She is led to believe that her husband's beatings are a fault of her own, and that it is her duty as his wife to behave well, seeing her husband's abuse as retribution for her own failings. Outside of their relationship, her husband describes her as a "boring lay." After Wekapipo discovers her near-blindness due to her husband's abuse, she downplays the severity of her injury by claiming that it is temporary and would heal soon. She expresses a level of affection for her brother and is brought to tears after her husband beats him and challenges him to

characters.title: Wes's Mother
characters.bio: Wes's Mother is an unnamed tertiary character featured in the sixth part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, Stone Ocean. Her last name is Bluemarine and her first name is unknown.
characters.personality: Mrs. Bluemarine's life had been filled with unhappiness, meaning the birth of her baby represented her sole source of hope, happiness, and pride for a brighter future. When her baby suddenly dies on the night of his birth, she suffers a severe psychological break. Unable to accept the loss of her child and the destruction of her newfound happiness, she resorts to the selfish and desperate act of stealing another family's child to replace her own. She completely represses the memory of her biological child's death, convincing herself for years that the stolen child is truly hers.

characters.title: Will Anthonio Zeppeli
characters.bio: Will Anthonio Zeppeli, also known as Baron Zeppeli, is a primary ally featured in the first part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, Phantom Blood.
characters.background: Will Anthonio Zeppeli was born on January 19, 1838. Zeppeli was born to a scholarly family, so he had always been interested in researching the unknown since his youth. When he became of age, he joined the archaeological group at his father's university and was able to travel to various places around the world. On one of his travels in 1858, the group went to Mexico to excavate an underground Aztec ruin. Amongst their findings was the Stone Mask. On the voyage home, several of the crew began to die off, until they realized that someone had put on the mask. It turned out to be the leader of the group, Zeppeli's father. All 58 crew members were slaughtered, but Zeppeli managed to escape by jum
characters.personality: Will Anthonio Zeppeli is a fearless but eccentric Ripple master dedicated to battling evil.

characters.title: Wilson Phillips
characters.name_ja: ウィルソン・フィリップス
characters.bio: Wilson Phillips is a tertiary character featured in the third part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, Stardust Crusaders.
characters.background: According to his inner monologue, he graduated high school and college at the top of his class (and as captain of his college wrestling team) and then went on to become a revered and respected politician. He then married a model 25 years younger than him and had a thousand acres of a villa in Hawaii. He also claims to pay 50 times the taxes an average person does.
characters.personality: On the exterior, Wilson Phillips takes on the persona of a humble, affable Senator. He remains calm and cordial even after DIO breaks his driver's arm, passing it off with a chuckle. This guise is quickly shattered when DIO pulls two of his teeth out. He reveals his true conceited nature, reassuring himself by listing his major accomplishments and believing that no one can stand in his way as a senator of the United States. He is extremely confident in his status, threatening to have DIO executed and claiming that he will be president and can crush anyone who stands in his way despite DIO's show of power. Although arrogant, he isn't willing to kill innocent people until he does so out of fea
characters.ja_kanji: ウィルソン・フィリップス

characters.title: Winzaleo
characters.bio: Winzaleo the Lion King is a tertiary character featured in the first part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, Phantom Blood.
characters.background: In 1327, Winzaleo is the first knight to survive and successfully complete the challenge of the 77 Rings. He goes down in history as a legendary knight alongside Eijkman, Caineghis, Bruford, and Tarkus.
characters.personality: His personality in the manga is unknown, as he was only mentioned. In the video game, Winzaleo seems to take pride in his title as the "Lion King", as he declares his title in battle. He is described in the game's Profile Mode as a knight who earned the title of "Lion King" due to his fierce appearance, skill with axes, strong build, and chivalrous spirit.

characters.title: Wired Beck
characters.bio: Wired Beck is a tertiary antagonist featured in the second part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, Battle Tendency, specifically in the "Climb Out of the Fortified Hotel" chapter.
characters.background: Wired Beck was a fugitive convicted for strangling his girlfriend. After breaking out, he eventually became one of Kars's servant vampires. As a vampire, Wired Beck has the unique ability to grow spikes from all over his body.
characters.personality: Wired Beck is a misogynistic, aggressive vampire who firmly believes women are inferior and deserve to be harmed, having at some point murdered his own girlfriend. He is particularly irritated by Lisa Lisa, threatening to 'punish her' for her attitude.

characters.title: Yokohama
characters.bio: Yokohama is a tertiary character featured in the ninth part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, The JOJOLands.
characters.personality: Yokohama is supposedly an excellent bank employee, having a luxurious office as a trophy of his work. When addressing Hacca Howler, he maintains his composure and stays respectful. However, in private, he consistently mocks Howler for his attitude and status. He has a gleeful attitude, even in stressful situations where he needs to urgently collect Howler's loan before Howler is arrested. However, the situation also makes him nervous enough to get a stomachache.
occupations: Dolphin Bank's General Sales Manager and Division Chief

characters.title: Yoshikage Kira (JoJolion)
characters.bio: Yoshikage Kira is a primary ally featured in the eighth part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, JoJolion. Introduced early in the story, Kira gains significance in the "Vitamin C and Killer Queen" story arc.
characters.background: Yoshikage Kira was born at some point in 1982, the son of Yoshiteru Kira and Holy Joestar-Kira. When he was 4, Yoshikage met with the Flemish Giant Rabbit Cindy, but broke two of his ribs the same day and was treated by his mother.
characters.personality: Although Yoshikage Kira has many unusual and dark personality traits, his love for his mother and loyalty to his allies put him on the side of good.

characters.title: Zeppeli's Father
characters.bio: Zeppeli's Father is an unnamed posthumous tertiary character featured in the first part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, Phantom Blood.
characters.personality: Will's father was knowledgeable with an interest in traveling and archaeology. Not much is known of his personality as a human, but he was respected by his son and capable of leading a large group of students.

characters.title: Zombie Commander
characters.name_ja:
ゾンビ司令官
吸血ゾンビ
characters.bio: The unnamed Zombie Commander, also known as the Bloodsucking Zombie, is a posthumous tertiary antagonist featured in the second part of JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, Battle Tendency.
characters.background: 50 years before the events of Battle Tendency, Straizo and Speedwagon made it their mission to eliminate the remaining zombies that Dio had created. Though they seemingly wiped them out, one was able to escape and hide in the shadows for decades.
characters.personality: Speedwagon describes him as a cunning zombie, being able to hide for so long as he wasn't attempting to multiply and never left any remains of its victims. He was capable of disguising himself as a member of society for decades, and found out about George's investigation into his identity before he could gather enough evidence against it.
characters.ja_kanji:
ゾンビ司令官
吸血ゾンビ
